- Stored in the root row's `anchor` JSON column (null for block comments and rows before 2.4): `{ path, start, end, quote: { exact, prefix, suffix } }`. `path`: data key path of the text field in the block (`text`, `caption`, `items.1.content`, `content.0.2`; `ANCHOR_PATH_PATTERN`, at most 8 keys, no `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype`) or null. `start`/`end`: base64 of an encoded Yjs `RelativePosition` (at most 512 bytes; both or none; only with a path) on that field's Y.Text in the live room, `start` with assoc 0 (first character of the range), `end` with assoc -1 (last character), so text typed at the edges does not join the range. `quote.exact` max 500 characters, `prefix`/`suffix` max 32, control characters except line feeds removed (`cleanAnchor`). The server validates the shape (strict zod) and never decodes the positions; the block id stays in `blockId`.
- Text model: a Y.Text holds the field's HTML source. `htmlTextMap(html)` gives the text a reader sees (tags dropped, `<br>` as a line feed, comments dropped, `&amp; &lt; &gt; &quot; &apos; &nbsp;`, numeric and a small set of named references decoded; a `<` not followed by a letter, `/`, `!` or `?` is text) with the source range of every UTF-16 unit; the admin builds the DOM text of the field element with the same rules (`domTextMap`). Offsets map through `textRangeToSource` / `sourceRangeToText` only when both texts are equal; otherwise only the quote is used.
- Creating (admin): selection inside one text element of one block (else a notice). The field element is matched to a data leaf by its text (n-th equal text = n-th equal leaf). With a live room (`collabClient.getDoc()`), pending typing is flushed first and the positions are encoded on the leaf's Y.Text; without one (collaboration off, `disableCollaboration`, a positional field before its key exists, read-only rooms are fine) the anchor is the quote (+ path from the block's saved data).
- Finding: relative positions in the current room doc (must resolve to the same Y.Text, non-empty), then the best quote match (prefix/suffix score) among the block's text elements, else `changed` ("Text changed", the thread stays on its block); a missing block is `detached` as before. One save that rewrites text on both sides of a range (one diff region per text) drops the positions; the quote then finds the text if it still exists.
- Painting: CSS Custom Highlight API `mex-comment` (open threads) and `mex-comment-active` (the thread the caret is in or that was jumped to), styles in `tools/styles.js`; a page-wide registry merges the ranges of all fields; the Editor.js DOM is never changed. Browsers without the API show no highlight (threads and markers still work).

Mentions (`shared/comment-mentions.mjs`, `services/comment-notifications.js`):

- Body stays plain text (`normalizeCommentBody`). Picking a person inserts `@<name>`; the client sends the ids whose `@<name>` is still in the text (`mentionsInText`). The server resolves the ids (active, not blocked admins), keeps only people whose own ability has `access` + `comments.read` and passes `access.checkField` (CM read on document, locale, field; identity incl. `fieldKey`), and stores their admin ids in the comment's `mentions` JSON column (max 20, never returned). Names are read live; a deleted admin's id no longer resolves (the text stays). The admin renders `@<name>` of listed people as chips (`mentionSegments`, `you` styled apart).
- Picker: active admins except the caller matching `q` on first name, last name or username (never e-mail), 25 candidates checked, 8 returned; `comments.mentionsPerMinute` (default 60) searches per admin (counter `mentions:<adminId>`, 429).

Notifications:

- Hidden content type `plugin::magic-editor-x.comment-notification` (table `magic_editor_comment_notifications`): `recipientId`, `kind` (`mention`|`reply`), `commentId`, `threadId`, `contentType`, `entryId`, `entryLocale`, `fieldName` (field identity), `blockId`, `readAt`, `emailedAt`. Ids only, no text. One row per recipient and comment; `mention` for newly mentioned people (also on edit; removed mentions delete their row), `reply` for the thread's other participants (root author, reply authors, people mentioned in the thread), never the author, at most 50 recipients, each re-checked like mentions.
- Listing (`notification`): `{ id, kind, read, createdAt, threadId, actor: { name, deleted }, snippet (comment text, one line, max 200), excerpt (thread excerpt), target: { kind: 'collectionType'|'singleType', uid, documentId, locale, field, fieldKey, typeName, title } }`. The newest 200 rows are scanned and each is checked against the caller's current access (rows of documents they can no longer read are hidden, not deleted). `title` is the Content Manager main field when the caller may read it, else null.
- Retention (same rules as comments): deleted with the comment (a thread root takes its thread's), with the entry locale (`removeForEntries`), and when the recipient admin is deleted (`anonymizeUser` lifecycle). Rows around the Document Service are not cleaned up.
- Admin: the comments panel shows "You were mentioned in N threads" / "New replies …" with "Mark as read", and per thread "Mentioned you" / "New reply". Homepage widget "Mentions and replies" (`app.widgets.register`, Strapi 5.13+, permissions `access` + `comments.read`; `components/MentionsWidget`): newest 5, unread count, mark read/unread, mark all read, polling every 60 s while the tab is visible and on focus. Links go to the Content Manager edit view with `plugins[i18n][locale]` and `mexThread=<threadId>` (`MentionsWidget/link.mjs`); the field that holds that thread opens its panel, focuses the thread (shows resolved threads for it) and marks its notifications read.

E-mail (opt-in): `comments.notifications.email` (default `false`) sends mention e-mails through `strapi.plugin('email').service('email').send` after the response (never blocks or fails the comment), at most `comments.notifications.emailPerHour` (default 10) per recipient (counter `mentionmail:<adminId>`). Content: "<name> mentioned you in a comment on "<title>" (<type>)" (title only when the recipient may read it) and the absolute admin link (`admin.absoluteUrl`); never the comment text. Since 2.5 in the recipient's admin interface language (see "2.5 fixes"; English before). Subject and names are header-safe (control characters, line and paragraph separators and bidi overrides removed, bounded); the address must match a strict single-address pattern; no `from`/`replyTo` from user input (the email plugin's defaults). An escaped HTML part is always sent (Strapi's nodemailer provider would otherwise send the text as HTML). Settings > Configuration shows the state read-only (`environment.mentionEmails: { enabled, available, perHour }`).

Keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+M comments on the selection (also in read-only editors, which show a floating "Comment" button next to the selection; the inline toolbar has "Comment" for editors, tool key `comment$mex`), Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+N / Shift: next / previous open comment (its text becomes active and the thread is focused); clicking commented text shows its thread without moving focus. In the comment boxes `@` opens the picker (combobox: arrows, Enter/Tab picks, Escape closes the list), Ctrl/Cmd+Enter posts and is stopped there (Strapi 5.61's edit view saves on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter).

Audit: `comment.mention` (`counts.mentions`, `meta.threadId`, block id) when new mention notifications were created; recipients are not recorded.

Tests: `tests/comment-anchors.test.mjs`, `tests/comment-mentions.test.mjs`, `tests/integration/comment-mentions.test.mjs` (`MEX_MAIL_LOG` + `MEX_MAIL_EXPECTED=on|off` for the e-mail case against a fake SMTP server).

## Synced blocks (2.3)

- Source: a row of `plugin::magic-editor-x.template` with `kind: 'synced'` (same fields, limits, sanitising, scope, `enabled`, order and `templates.manage` permission as templates and patterns; managed on Settings > Templates with the kind filter). Chosen over a content type of its own because the stored shape, validation, settings UI and permission are identical; the differences are kind-specific branches in `services/templates.js`. Rules: a source never contains a `synced` block (400 `fieldErrors.blocks` "A synced block cannot contain another synced block"; the admin form checks it too), so references cannot nest or form cycles; the kind of a source never changes and a template/pattern never becomes a source (400 `fieldErrors.kind`); `enabled: false` only stops offering it for insertion (`GET /templates/:id` still returns it, references keep rendering it). Sources are not localised and have no Draft & Publish: a saved change is live in published output at once (that is the point of the feature).
- Field value: block `{ type: 'synced', data: { ref: <source documentId> } }`, nothing else (policy: invalid refs become `''`; schema `data_synced`; types `SyncedData`). Stored as `{ ref, _mex: 1 }` (built-in marker, see Media Library blocks > Compatibility): a pre-2.3 custom block named `synced` keeps the generic policy and its own tool; new custom blocks cannot use the name. Presets: in `full` and `article`, not in `basic`/`minimal`; `allowedBlocks` may list it; `checkPreset` reports `BLOCK_NOT_ALLOWED`. The Yjs guard refuses a built-in synced block whose data is not exactly `{ ref, _mex? }` with a documentId (or `''`). `computeStats` counts no text for it (limits count the reference as one block).
- Expansion (`shared/synced.mjs` `expandSynced(data, lookup, { filter, maxBlocks, maxBytes })`): each reference is replaced by a deep copy of the source blocks with ids `<refBlockId>-<sourceBlockId>` (hashed when longer than 64 characters, unique in the document); references inside a source are dropped; toggle `items` counts of enclosing toggles are recomputed (`replaceBlocks`, `toBlockTree`/`fromBlockTree`); a missing source, a source with no allowed block, or one that would exceed 5000 blocks / ~5 MiB expands to nothing. `origins` maps copied ids to the reference.
- Preset interaction (decided: filter, not refuse): `templates.mjs` `filterSyncedForField(blocks, preset)` leaves out blocks of types the containing field does not allow (a disallowed toggle's content stays), fixes heading levels and links like "Fix automatically", leaves out unfixable blocks and images without alt in `requireAlt` fields. Refusing the field save was rejected because a source can change after the field was saved. The editor view shows "N blocks of the source are not allowed in this field and left out".
- Content API / GraphQL (`services/references.js` `expandAll`, before reference collection): one query for all sources of a response (`templates.syncedSources(ids)`, at most `SYNCED_LIMITS.refsPerResponse` = 100 distinct sources), each source cleaned with the containing field's sanitiser (`cleanEditorValue` with the configured `rawHtml` and the preset's inline tags) and filtered by its preset (`render-output.js` and `graphql.js` pass `attribute.options`). Permission model: sources are shared editorial content an author embedded on purpose, so they are expanded for every caller who can read the containing entry; internal links, mentions, embedded entries and media inside them are resolved with the caller's permissions like any other reference (unreadable targets become plain text / `null`). `json` output has the copied blocks inline with `syncedFrom: <ref>`; without `?mex` the stored reference is returned unchanged.
- Renderers: option `synced` (`{ [ref]: document | blocks }`, a `Map`, or `(ref) => document | blocks | null`) in `renderHtml`/`renderText`/`renderMarkdown`/`renderTree` and the React/Vue components (`prepareBlocks` expands before cleaning, so the copies are cleaned and rendered like any block and a `toc` lists their headings); without it, or for an unknown ref, a synced block renders nothing.
- Usage (`GET /templates/:id/usage`, `templates.usage`): a bounded scan of the stored data (every `api::` type with editor fields, top level/components/dynamic zones, drafts and published versions, all locales, batches of 100 by id; `USAGE_LIMITS` 200,000 rows / 20 s, then `complete: false`) plus templates/patterns that contain the reference. A scan instead of an index table: it reads what is stored, so edits through the Content Manager, the Content API, scripts or imports are all counted, without write hooks on publish, discard, delete or locale operations. Counts only.
- History: versions store the reference only; restoring restores the reference; old versions render the current source (like a component). The diff shows "Synced block <name>" (`syncedDiffRefs`; `leafKind` treats `ref` as a value). Source versions are kept since 2.4 (see "Audit trail, synced source versions and the link check").
- Admin: tool `tools/synced.js` (no toolbox entry; inserted from the "Insert template" dialog's "Synced blocks" section, offered only where the preset allows `synced`; `GET /templates?uid&field` filters them). The tool hands its `data-mutation-free` element to the field (`config.mount`), which renders `SyncedBlockView` through a React portal: "Synced block: <name>", the source rendered with `RenderedContent` after `filterSyncedForField`, "Edit source" (`LinkButton isExternal` to `/settings/magic-editor-x/templates?edit=<id>`, only with `templates.manage`), "Detach" (editors: the reference is replaced by a copy through `prepareInsertion` and `replaceContent`, fresh ids, one undo step), "Synced block removed" when the source is gone (404). Sources load through `editor/synced-store.js` (one cache per page, shared requests, refresh on focus/visibility, every 30 s while visible, `MAX_AGE_MS` 15 s). The in-field preview passes the sources as `options.synced`. Keydown on the view's controls does not reach Editor.js.

## Block suggestions and review workflows (2.4)

Reviewers propose block changes; editors accept or reject them. Block level only: Editor.js 2.x keeps no change marks in its saved data and every tool owns its DOM, so character-level track changes are out of reach; a suggestion is one whole proposed block, shown with the word diff of `shared/diff.mjs`.

Data (`plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestion`, table `magic_editor_suggestions`, hidden from the Content Manager and the Content-Type Builder, no Content API route, index `(entry_id, field_name, content_type)`): `contentType`, `entryId`, `entryLocale` (null without i18n), `fieldName` (the field identity of `access.checkField(...).fieldName`; never a positional path), `blockId` (`/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`: the block changed or deleted, or the inserted block's new id), `op` (`update`|`insert`|`delete`), `afterBlockId` (inserts: the block it goes after, null = at the start; may be another open insert's block), `proposed` (`{ id, type, data, tunes? }`, null for deletes; normalised, sanitised with the field's sanitiser and inline tags of the field preset and the `rawHtml` policy, then checked with `checkPreset` without the whole-document rules `TOO_MANY_BLOCKS`/`TOO_MANY_CHARACTERS`; at most 64 KiB canonical JSON), `baseHash` (`shared/suggestions.mjs` `blockHash` of the block when it was suggested; null for inserts), `note` (plain text, comment rules, max 1000), `status` (`open`|`accepted`|`rejected`), `authorId` + `authorName`, `decidedAt`, `decidedById` + `decidedByName` (snapshots, cleared when the admin user is deleted; ids are never returned), 2.9 `origin` (string, max 64: `ai:<action key>` when an AI review made it for the author, null when the author wrote it; DTO `ai: { action } | null`).

`blockHash`: cyrb53 (53 bit) of canonical JSON of `type`, `data` without unset leaves (`false`, `null`, `''`) and the non-default tunes (`diffTunes({}, tunes)`; the editor writes `alignmentTune: left`, `textVariant: ''`, `indentTune: 0` on every block, stored content has none). The admin hashes blocks normalised with `prepareEditorValue`.

"Outdated" is derived in the editor, never stored: `suggestionState(suggestion, current)` against the live content (shared room plus unsaved edits) is `open`, `outdated` (the block's hash differs from `baseHash`; inserts: the anchor is gone), `applied` (the content already equals the proposal; inserts: the id exists) or `missing` (update/delete of a block that is gone: reject only). A stored state would go stale with every live edit.

Routes (prefix `/magic-editor-x`, all with `admin::isAuthenticatedAdmin` + `admin::hasPermissions`; every handler checks Content Manager read on the document, locale and field with `services/access.js` `checkField` and answers 404 otherwise, also for suggestion ids of other documents; handlers log nothing):

| Method | Path                      | Actions                                   | Handler                | Input                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Output                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------ | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/suggestions`            | access (+ create or review, handler: 403) | `suggestions.list`     | `?uid&documentId&locale&field&fieldKey&status` (strict; `status` `open` default or `all`)                                                                                                                                           | `{ data: [suggestion], meta: { counts: { open, accepted, rejected }, canCreate, canReview, fieldKey } }` oldest first; `canReview` also needs CM update; keyless positional field: empty, both false |
| POST   | `/suggestions`            | access, suggestions.create                | `suggestions.create`   | `{ uid, documentId, locale?, field, fieldKey?, note?, suggestions: [1..50 of { op: 'update', blockId, proposed, baseHash } \| { op: 'insert', blockId, afterBlockId, proposed } \| { op: 'delete', blockId, baseHash }] }` (strict) | 201 `{ data: [suggestion], meta: { created, updated } }`; an open suggestion of the caller for the same block and op is replaced                                                                     |
| POST   | `/suggestions/:id/accept` | access, suggestions.review                | `suggestions.accept`   | `{ outdated?: boolean }` (strict; recorded in the audit counts)                                                                                                                                                                     | `{ data: suggestion }` (status `accepted`, with `proposed`)                                                                                                                                          |
| POST   | `/suggestions/:id/reject` | access, suggestions.review                | `suggestions.reject`   | `{}`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `{ data: suggestion }`                                                                                                                                                                               |
| DELETE | `/suggestions/:id`        | access, suggestions.create                | `suggestions.withdraw` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `{ data: { id } }`; author only, open only (the row is deleted)                                                                                                                                      |

Suggestion DTO: `{ id, op, blockId, afterBlockId, proposed, baseHash, note, status, author: { name, own, deleted }, decidedAt, decidedBy: { name }|null, createdAt, updatedAt }`. Errors: 400 strict validation, `INVALID_BLOCK`, `PRESET_VIOLATION` (`details.blockIds`, `details.violations[].code`), `SUGGESTION_TOO_LARGE`, `DUPLICATE_SUGGESTION`, `TOO_MANY_SUGGESTIONS` (500 open per field and locale); 403 accept/reject without CM update, withdraw of someone else's; 404 not readable or `suggestions.enabled: false`; 409 `FIELD_KEY_REQUIRED` (positional field without a stored key), `ALREADY_DECIDED` (accept, reject and withdraw are conditional updates on `status: 'open'`: one decision wins); 429 `suggestions.perMinute` requests per admin (counter `suggestions:<adminId>` in `magic_editor_x_counters`).

| Action                                      | uid in `registerMany` | Meaning                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestions.create` | `suggestions.create`  | Suggest (CM read on the document and field is enough: reviewers suggest); withdraw own |
| `plugin::magic-editor-x.suggestions.review` | `suggestions.review`  | Accept and reject (also needs CM update on the document, locale and field)             |

`GET /config` adds `data.suggestions: { enabled }` and `permissions.suggestionsCreate`, `permissions.suggestionsReview`. Config: `suggestions.enabled` (default `true`; the UI only appears for admins with one of the two actions, which no role has after the upgrade), `suggestions.perMinute` (default 20). Audit events (ids and counts only): `suggestion.create` (`counts.suggestions|created|updated|updates|inserts|deletes`, up to 20 block ids), `suggestion.accept` (`counts.outdated` 0/1), `suggestion.reject`, `suggestion.withdraw` (`meta.suggestionId`, `meta.op`, the block id). Retention: `utils/comment-retention.js` also deletes the suggestions of deleted document locales and anonymises authors and deciders of deleted admin users.

Admin:

- Suggest mode (`SuggestEditor.jsx`) is a second, local Editor.js instance on a copy of what the field shows. The field's own editor is set read-only and hidden (`inert`) meanwhile and keeps receiving live changes; the copy has no form, room, server or undo connection of the field, so typing, paste, Markdown shortcuts, the table tool, undo (its own history), templates, find and replace, AI and footnotes can never write to the shared document or the form: the field's toolbar, panels and global shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F, Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+P, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+G) are off in suggest mode, and the copy is built without AI, Media Library, uploads (a suggestion creates no assets before review) and the footnote dialog. Chosen over "read-only plus a per-block proposal editor" because editing several blocks, inserting and deleting stay the normal editor gestures, and over guarding every write path of the field's editor because one missed path would leak edits into the live room. "Send suggestions" diffs the copy against the base (`suggestionsFromDiff`: `diffDocuments` alignment by id then similarity; a block paired by similarity updates the base block; reorders are not suggested and are counted in the dialog) and creates one suggestion per changed, inserted or deleted block; the dialog shows the counts and takes an optional note. Leaving with unsent changes asks first (ConfirmDialog) and the browser warns on unload.
- Entry points: "Suggest changes" and "Suggestions (n open)" in the field's More menu; contextual only: "You cannot edit this field, but you can suggest changes" with a "Suggest changes" button under a field the admin cannot edit, and "n open suggestions · Review suggestions" under the field while any are open. No new toolbar icon.
- Review (`SuggestionsPanel.jsx`, `SuggestionMarkers.jsx`, `useSuggestions.js`): markers at the inline end of blocks with open suggestions (beside a comment marker; the holder gets a second marker column only while a block has both), the panel lists open suggestions in document order with the word diff against the block as it is now, author, time, note, state badge, Accept, Reject, Withdraw (own, ConfirmDialog) and Show block; Accept on an outdated suggestion asks first; "Accept all" (ConfirmDialog) accepts the suggestions in `open` state and leaves outdated ones. Accept first marks the suggestion accepted on the server (only one reviewer wins), then applies the server-sanitised proposed block through `replaceContent` (`applySuggestions`, inserts follow the chain of open inserts): one undo step, live collaborators see it, the form gets dirty and the normal save stores it. No version is created per accept ("Before suggestion"): undo covers it until the save, the save is versioned as usual, and "Accept all" of many suggestions would create many versions. Polling like comments (15 s, 8 s with the panel open, on focus and after own actions).

Editor.js limits met: `editor.save()` of a read-only instance did not return the content, so suggest mode starts from the content the field shows; Editor.js writes default tunes and unset data leaves on save (handled by `blockHash`); "/" pressed right after Enter, before Editor.js moved the caret into the new block (next tick), is typed as text instead of opening the toolbox; an active Editor.js Flipper (document capture keydown handler) takes the first Tab presses (three measured) in any dialog opened from an editor, also the field's own dialogs (keyboard shortcuts dialog), so the suggest editor closes its toolbars before the send dialog opens, which does not cover every case. (2.5: the key guard in `admin/src/editor/focus-guard.mjs` covers every case, see "2.5 fixes".)

Strapi review workflows (decided: no stage hook in 2.4). Read in the installed 5.61.1 source: `@strapi/review-workflows/dist/server/index.js` registers services, routes, controllers and the Document Service middlewares only when `strapi.ee.features.isEnabled('review-workflows')` (license feature, `@strapi/core/dist/ee/index.js` `features.isEnabled = get(name) !== undefined` over `ee.licenseInfo.features`); otherwise only the `workflow`/`workflow-stage` content types load, so a Community Edition host has no stage attribute, no stage route and nothing to change. A stage change is `PUT /review-workflows/content-manager/(collection|single)-types/:model_uid/:id/stage` (`routes/review-workflows.js`, `enableFeatureMiddleware('review-workflows')`, `controllers/stages.js` `updateEntity`: stage transition permissions, then `services/stages.js` `updateEntity`), which writes `strapi.documents(model).update({ documentId, locale, data: { strapi_stage: { id } } })`; the review-workflows middleware `handleStageOnUpdate` (`services/document-service-middleware.js`) runs around it. A plugin could refuse it with a Document Service middleware that throws a `ValidationError` when `ctx.action === 'update'` and `ctx.params.data.strapi_stage` names a configured stage while the quality gate fails; deleting a stage moves entries with knex (`stages.updateEntitiesStage`) around the Document Service, which no middleware sees. None of this can be exercised end to end without an Enterprise/Growth license with the `review-workflows` feature, so no untested code ships. Review workflows also have their own "required stage for publishing" (`checkStageBeforePublish`). The Content Manager side panel with open suggestion and comment counts was left out: the counts are already in each field (markers, notice, menu) and a panel per edit view would add requests for every document type without a new decision for the editor.

Tests: `tests/suggestions.test.mjs` (hash, diff to suggestions, states, apply, markers, notes, routes and actions, fake-DB service and controller: sanitising, preset, strict input, RBAC, conditional decisions, rate limit, positional key, retention), `tests/integration/suggestions.test.mjs` (SQLite and PostgreSQL hosts).

## Entry panel, presence and widgets (2.5)

One Content Manager side panel ("Magic Editor X", `addEditViewSidePanel` in the admin `bootstrap`) and two homepage widgets. The panel is a description component (`admin/src/components/EntryPanel/index.jsx`) that returns `{ title, content }` or `null`: hidden while an entry is created, for content types without a Magic Editor X field (also inside components and dynamic zones, `hasEditorFields`) and for admins without `access` (`useRBAC`). Its body is lazy-loaded (`Content.jsx`).

- **Sections** (`admin/src/components/EntryPanel/sections.jsx`, `ENTRY_PANEL_SECTIONS`): "Editing now" (presence), a shared loading/error row, "Comments" (open threads per field, needs `comments.read` and `comments.enabled`), "Quality" (lint errors and warnings of the saved draft per field, broken links of the scheduled link check for draft and published). To add a section, append `{ id, Component }` to the list: `Component` receives `{ t, target: { uid, documentId, locale }, presence, summary }` and returns `null` when it has nothing to show; wrap the content in `EntryPanelSection` (`{ title, testId }`: a `section` with an `h3`; sections are separated by a rule). Other features never add their own side panel.
- **Opening a field's panel**: the rows' buttons dispatch `magic-editor-x:open-field-panel` (`admin/src/editor/entry-panel-events.mjs` `requestFieldPanel({ field, path, panel: 'comments'|'quality' })`). The `EditorField` whose identity matches (`fieldIdentity(path, savedKey)`, or the path for a positional field without a saved key) opens the panel, scrolls into view and sets `detail.handled`. A field that is not mounted (inside a collapsed component entry of the form) does not answer; the row then says to open that group first.
- **Presence** (`services/entry-panel.js` `presence`): the panel sends `POST /presence` every 15 s while it is mounted (`useEntryPresence`: one request is heartbeat and read; idle after 60 s without keyboard or pointer input or while the tab is hidden; doubles the wait after failures up to 2 minutes, at least 60 s after 429; stops on 403/404; `leave: true` on unmount through `getFetchClient`, because `useFetchClient` aborts on unmount). Callers who may update the document locale get a row in `magic_editor_x_collab_presence` with room `<uid>|<documentId>|<locale or ->|@entry`, id `sha256('entry|<adminId>|<tabId>')`, name and colour like collaboration tokens (`displayName`, `colorFor`; never an e-mail address), `cursor` `{"idle":true}` or null. The answer lists other admins with `can_edit` from every live row with the document prefix (one `LIKE ... ESCAPE '!'` query, re-checked with `startsWith`, at most 200 rows, 20 people): heartbeat rows and the socket rows of every field room, positional rooms included (`<base>#<key>` shares the prefix), across processes. A person is `idle` when all their rows are idle and `live` when one row is a socket. Rows live 30 s (closed tabs expire, a crashed process leaves no ghost); the panel prunes stale rows at most once a minute per process (collaboration maintenance does too). Entry rows never count against `maxConnectionsPerAdmin`/`maxRoomsPerAdmin` (`store.presenceOfUser` skips them). Reading needs Content Manager read on the document locale (`access.checkDocument`, 404 otherwise), so only names of admins who passed the same check are shown to people who may read the entry.
- **Collaboration off** (`collaboration.enabled: false` or a field with `disableCollaboration`): presence still works from the heartbeats (no sockets, `live` false); nothing else changes. The panel does not use the field sockets for presence: rooms are per field and exist only for admins with `collaborate`, while the panel must show everyone who has the entry open.
- **Soft lock** (`presence.softLock`, default false): when other editors are active (not idle) and the caller may update the entry, a Dialog with one action ("Continue editing", focused) explains it once per tab and entry (`sessionStorage`). It never blocks saving.
- **Entry summary** (`summary`): the saved draft is read once with the publish-guard query of all editor fields; fields the caller cannot read (field-level CM permissions) are left out (max 100). Per field: `path`, `label` (indices from 1: `sections 1 › body`), `field` (identity, null for a positional field without a saved key), `positional`, `issues { errors, warnings }` (`lintDocument`, `requireAlt` from the preset; no TeX check on the server), `openThreads` (one grouped comment query; null without `comments.read`), `brokenLinks { draft, published }` (one `getLinkFields` by primary key for all identities and versions, one `getLinkUrls`; problem statuses `broken`, `timeout`, `error`). The panel reloads it after each save (`document.updatedAt`) and on window focus (at most every 10 s).
- **Widgets** (`admin/src/components/EntryWidgets`, registered in `register` like "Mentions and replies"): "My open threads" (`open-threads`, actions `access` + `comments.read`): unresolved root threads the caller started (`authorId`) or was mentioned in (mention notifications), newest activity first, scan bounded to 200 + 200 rows, only on fields the caller can read (`checkField`, at most 60 distinct checks per call), links to the entry with `mexThread`. "Broken links" (`broken-links`, action `access`): entries with problems in the last scheduled run, computed once per finished run per process (bounded scans: 5000 problem URLs, 50 000 link rows, 1000 entries; `meta.truncated`), filtered by `checkField` on a field with the problem, title only when the caller may read the main field; no URLs. Both poll every 60 s while visible.

| Route                       | Handler                  | Actions                   | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST /presence`            | `entryPanel.presence`    | `access`                  | body `{ uid, documentId, locale?, tabId: [A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}, idle?, leave? }` (strict); `{ data: { enabled, softLock, canEdit, editors: [{ id, name, color, idle, live }] } }`; 404 without CM read; 429 above `presence.perMinute` per admin (shared counter `presence:<adminId>`) |
| `GET /entry-summary`        | `entryPanel.summary`     | `access`                  | `?uid&documentId&locale` (strict); `{ data: { fields, comments: { enabled, open }, quality: { errors, warnings }, links: { enabled, lastRun, draft, published } } }`; 404 without CM read; 60/min                                                                                     |
| `GET /widgets/open-threads` | `entryPanel.openThreads` | `access`, `comments.read` | `?pageSize` 1-20 (default 5); `{ data: [{ threadId, started, mentioned, excerpt, snippet, updatedAt, target: { kind, uid, documentId, locale, typeName, title } }], meta: { more } }`; 404 when comments are off; 60/min (shared with broken links)                                   |
| `GET /widgets/broken-links` | `entryPanel.brokenLinks` | `access`                  | `?pageSize` 1-20; `{ data: [{ problems, target }], meta: { enabled, lastRun: { finishedAt, complete } \| null, more, truncated } }`                                                                                                                                                   |

No new permission. Config (`presence`): `enabled` (true; false: the panel hides "Editing now", nothing is written), `softLock` (false), `perMinute` (30, 1-600). Every response has `Cache-Control: no-store`; handlers log nothing. Tests: `tests/entry-panel.test.mjs`, `tests/integration/entry-panel.test.mjs` (needs a type without editor fields, `api::tag.tag` or `MEX_ENTRY_PLAIN_UID`, and the fake link server origin `MEX_ENTRY_LINK_PORT`, default 2515, allowed for the scheduled link check), cluster proof `node scripts/cluster-acceptance.mjs ... --proof presence` (`scripts/cluster/presence-proof.mjs`).

## MCP tools for AI clients (2.5)

Magic Editor X registers tools, resources and a prompt with Strapi's own MCP server (`strapi.ai.mcp`, Strapi 5.47+, GA in 5.49; checked against the installed 5.61.1 `@strapi/core/dist/services/mcp/*`, `@strapi/types/dist/modules/mcp.d.ts` and docs.strapi.io "MCP server" / "Extending the MCP server with plugins"). Code: `server/src/mcp.js` (registration, status), `server/src/utils/mcp-tools.js` (pure handlers, zod schemas, guide text), `server/src/utils/mcp-runner.js` + `mcp-worker.js` (worker thread), `shared/preset-schema.mjs` (`buildPresetSchema(preset)`, `describePreset`), `shared/json-schema-check.mjs` (minimal JSON Schema validator, also used by the tests).

- **Off by default.** Registered in `register()` only when the plugin option `mcp.enabled` is `true` **and** Strapi's MCP server is on (`server.mcp.enabled: true` in `config/server`). Plugin on but server off (or Strapi < 5.47): one warning, nothing registered. Strapi serves `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless, one server per request; other methods 405).
- **Auth.** Strapi authenticates every `/mcp` request with an **admin token** (`Authorization: Bearer`, Settings > Admin Tokens; Content API tokens, admin session JWTs and missing tokens get HTTP 401 with JSON-RPC error `-32000 Authentication required`). Every capability below has `auth: { policies: [{ action: 'plugin::magic-editor-x.mcp.use' }] }`: Strapi lists and runs it only for tokens whose permissions include that action (the token's permissions are a subset of its owner's). Without it: not listed, and a call answers JSON-RPC `-32602 Tool|Resource|Prompt <name> disabled`. Nothing is `devModeOnly`.
- **Pure transformations.** The tools read and write no documents, make no outgoing requests, read no secrets and log no content (one info line with counts at registration). They run the save path: `cleanEditorValue(value, { rawHtml: config rawHtml, inlineTags: allowedInlineTags(preset) })` + `checkPreset`, so a returned value is stored unchanged by the Document Service middleware, which still cleans and checks every write (also writes of Strapi's Content Manager MCP tools, whose schema for a custom JSON field is `{}`). Handlers return fixed error texts (`<CODE>: <message>`, `isError: true`) for `EditorDataError`; any other error goes to Strapi's safe wrapper.
- **Worker thread.** The converters are synchronous and some inputs take super-linear time in marked (long `*`/`_` delimiter runs: 200,000 characters of `_a_` took 42 s on the main thread) and htmlparser2/sanitize-html (deeply nested inline tags), so every tool call runs in one worker thread (`server/src/utils/mcp-runner.js`, script `mcp-worker.js`, built to `dist/server/mcp-worker.js` and found with `require.resolve('./mcp-worker.js')` by both bundles): one call at a time, 10 s limit per call (the worker is terminated, the call answers `TIMEOUT`, the next call starts a new worker), at most 20 waiting calls (`BUSY`), worker heap 512 MiB (`TOO_LARGE` on out-of-memory), unknown failures `INTERNAL`. Markdown nested deeper than marked's recursion allows (`RangeError`) answers `TOO_DEEP`. The worker is stopped in `destroy`.
- **Names** use underscores: the MCP spec allows dots (`[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}`, SDK `validateToolName`), but Strapi's own tools use `[a-z0-9_-]` and LLM tool APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) reject dots, so `mex.fromMarkdown` would need renaming in clients.

| Capability    | Name / URI                                                                              | Input (strict zod, plugin's zod 4.6 via Standard Schema)                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Output (`structuredContent`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tool          | `mex_from_markdown`                                                                     | `markdown` (≤ 1,000,000 chars), `preset?` (`full`\|`article`\|`basic`\|`minimal`), `fieldOptions?` (`allowedBlocks` ≤ 2000, `headingLevels` ≤ 100, `maxBlocks`, `maxCharacters` 0..10^7, `requireAlt`, `linkTargets`), `fix?` (default true: `fixPresetViolations`) | `{ value \| null, violations, fixed, removed, notes, stats }`; `notes` as the migration report plus `images-not-uploaded` (image URLs kept, nothing copied to the Media Library)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Tool          | `mex_from_html`                                                                         | `html` (≤ 1,000,000), same preset keys, `fix?`                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | same                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Tool          | `mex_validate`                                                                          | `value` (object with `blocks` ≤ 5000, 1.x string ≤ 1,000,000, or null), `preset?`, `fieldOptions?`                                                                                                                                                                  | `{ valid, issues: [{ severity: error\|warning, code, message, path?, blockId?, index?, params? }] (≤ 100), value (as stored), stats }`; codes `TOO_LARGE`, `TOO_MANY_BLOCKS`, `TOO_DEEP`, `INVALID_SHAPE`, `BLOCK_DROPPED`, `SCHEMA` (preset schema on the cleaned value, not repeated for blocks with a preset violation), `REMOVED_ON_SAVE`, `CHANGED_ON_SAVE` (warning), preset codes of `checkPreset`. Messages never contain input text |
| Tool          | `mex_render`                                                                            | `value`, `format?` (`html` default \| `text` \| `markdown`)                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `{ format, output, blocks }` (package renderers, MathML for math, references not resolved, raw HTML blocks left out)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Resource (×4) | `magic-editor-x://presets/<full\|article\|basic\|minimal>/schema` (`mex-preset-<name>`) | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `application/schema+json`: the published schema narrowed to the preset (block type enum, heading level enum, `maxItems`), plus `x-mex-preset` (blocks, inline tools, heading levels, limits, `requireAlt`, `linkTargets`); no `$id`                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Prompt        | `mex_content_guide`                                                                     | `preset?`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | One user message: document shape, preset rules, common block data, workflow (convert, validate, render, save with the Content Manager tools)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Limits: Strapi's SDK caps tool input at `server.mcp.maxToolInputElements` (default 10000 elements), so very large `value` objects are refused before the handler. Status for the admin: `GET /magic-editor-x/settings` -> `data.environment.mcp = { enabled, serverEnabled, active, path: '/mcp' }`, shown read-only as the last row "Tools for AI clients (MCP)" of Settings > Magic Editor X > Configuration > Server configuration (no new route, no new UI control). Tests: `tests/mcp.test.mjs` (handlers, schemas, registration with a fake `strapi.ai.mcp`), `tests/integration/mcp.test.mjs` (raw JSON-RPC against `/mcp`; `MEX_MCP_EXPECT=off` for a host started with `mcp.enabled: false`).

Live Preview (roadmap item 4): re-checked on Strapi 5.62.0 in 2.6, see "Live Preview: block attributes and click-to-locate (2.6)" and `docs/live-preview.md`. Inline typing in the front end stays impossible; 2.6 ships block attributes, click-to-locate and a front-end guide.

## 2.5 fixes (2.5)

Six known issues of 2.4, fixed without new routes, permissions, config keys or stored shapes. Tests: `tests/focus-25.test.mjs`, `tests/collab-empty.test.mjs`, the 2.5 cases in `tests/field-identity.test.mjs`, `tests/synced-versions.test.mjs` and `tests/comment-mentions.test.mjs`, and `tests/integration/fixes-25.test.mjs` (host requirements in CONTRIBUTING.md).

- **Keys typed outside the editors** (`admin/src/editor/focus-guard.mjs` `installEditorKeyGuard`, installed once per window by every `EditorField`, reference counted). Editor.js 2.31 listens to `keydown` on `document` (capture) and, while one of its blocks is current, hands keys typed anywhere on the page to that block (`UI.defaultBehaviour` -> `BlockEvents.keydown`). Clicking a button does not reset the current block (the selection stays in the editor, `documentClicked` checks `isAtEditor`), so Tab in a dialog opened from an editor moved the editor caret to the next input behind the dialog and was prevented (one swallowed Tab per input below the caret; with a non-default last block it inserted an empty paragraph), and Tab in another form field jumped into the editor. Fix: a `window` capture listener shadows `event.keyCode` (and `event.code` for Ctrl/Cmd+/) with neutral values for Backspace, Tab, Enter, arrows and Delete whose target is an element outside every `.codex-editor` other than `body`/`html`; a listener on the root element (capture, after `document`) removes the shadow, so dialogs, menus, React and Radix see the real event. Keys inside an editor (Tab between table cells, the suggest-mode editor) and on `body` (block selection) are untouched; Escape is never touched. Applies to every Magic Editor X dialog, popover, menu and panel and to the other fields of the form, without per-dialog code.
- **Remote deletes keep the focus** (`focus-guard.mjs` `deleteBlockKeepingFocus`, every delete in `editor/apply-remote.js`). Editor.js `blocks.delete` ends with `Caret.setToBlock(currentBlock, END)` (and inserts a default block when the last one goes): a live catch-up that removed a block pulled the focus into the field and dropped the next keys typed elsewhere. The focused element (and the caret of a text field, or the document selection when the focus was in editable content) is put back; when the focus was inside the deleted block, Editor.js's placement stands.
- **Live editing of an empty field** (found while reproducing the focus issue; `shared/collab-replica.mjs` `restrictView`). A room seeded from an empty value has no blocks, Editor.js shows its default paragraph. That paragraph was part of the diff base (the startup view and `markShown(catchUp, shown)`), so local pushes created its block entry without adding the id to `order`: nothing typed into an empty field reached the other editors (measured: 0 of 1 edits arrived after 20 s with 2.4.0). The base now only holds blocks the room (or the stored value) has.
- **Discard keeps field keys** (`server/src/utils/field-identity.js` `registerDiscardKeys`, `discardKeyPlan`). Strapi 5.61 replaces the draft with a copy of the published version (new component rows). A Document Service middleware on `discardDraft` (registered after the audit trail, so its "after" read sees the keys) reads the positional editor values of the draft before and after (`positionalBasePaths`, one read per base path and locale) and writes the old key into each new keyless entry that shares block ids with exactly one old entry, and vice versa (`ownerOfBlocks` both ways), each key once, with `db.query(<component uid>).update` on the new component row (no middleware, lifecycle or audit event; a 1.x string value is written as its normalised object). Entries without such evidence stay keyless (2.4 behaviour). The published version is not changed.
- **Emptied entries keep their key** (`register.js` save middleware, `readPositionalEntries`, store `rememberFieldKeys` / `rememberedFieldKeys` / `forgetFieldKeys`). An entry emptied and saved is stored as `null` as before (required checks, renderers, Content API and GraphQL output unchanged). On `update`, when a positional value of an existing component row (`id` sent) becomes `null`, its key is remembered in `magic_editor_x_locks` as `fk:<scope>|<component row id>` (`scope` = first 40 hex of sha256 of uid, documentId, locale (Document Service default locale when none), base path; expires after 400 days, pruned with the other expired lock rows). `readPositionalEntries` gives a `null` entry its remembered key (`remembered: true`), so `checkField`, history, comments and rooms resolve the entry while it is empty. When the row gets content again, the remembered key wins over a key that is stored nowhere else in the document (the admin generates one for an empty field) and the memory is removed. Reads: one draft read per base path for writes that send `null` or keyless values of existing rows, or rows with a remembered key (one indexed `LIKE` query per base path). Limits: discarding the draft of an emptied entry loses its memory (new component rows).
- **Synced source versions ignore default tunes** (`services/synced-versions.js` `versionHash` uses `comparableBlocks`, like the field version hash). Versions stored by 2.4 carry a hash over the default tunes: the latest version's content is hashed again before a new version is created.
- **Mention e-mails in the recipient's language** (`server/src/utils/mention-mail.js`): the admin user's `preferedLanguage` (Strapi's spelling; primary subtag, `pt-BR` -> `pt`) selects `en`, `de` (formal), `fr`, `es` (formal) or `pt`; anything else is English. Placeholders `{actor}`, `{title}`, `{type}`, `{url}` are filled by plain replacement (no ICU, `$` patterns inert) with the header-safe values; the HTML part escapes them; still no comment text.

Editor.js limits measured for `docs/engine-decision.md`: the document keydown handler reaches keys typed anywhere on the page while a block is current (4 of 4 Tab presses swallowed in the version history dialog with 4 blocks below the caret); `blocks.delete` always moves the caret; an empty editor always shows a block that is not content.

## Use existing content: insert from another entry and the block clipboard (2.5)

Two ways to reuse blocks of one Magic Editor X field in another, both ending in the same pure plan (`shared/reuse.mjs` `planReuseInsertion`) and the same editor path as templates (`replaceContent`: Editor.js block API, the shared Yjs document, one undo step, the form, the normal save):

- **Insert from another entry** (More tools > Write, tool id `reuse`, `components/EditorField/ReuseDialog.jsx`): type and language default to the field's own (pickers with one choice are hidden), the entry list is the internal-link search (`GET /links/search`, Content Manager read permissions apply), the field picker defaults to the same field path, a preview lists the source blocks with a checkbox each (all insertable ones ticked) and the reason for blocks that cannot go in. One primary button "Insert N blocks"; the blocks go after the block worked on last (an empty field is replaced), the caret goes to the first inserted block. Visible only for editable fields with `config.reuse.enabled`.
- **Block clipboard**: blocks selected in Editor.js (two Ctrl/Cmd+A, Ctrl/Cmd+C) or copied with "Copy block" in the block menu (`tools/tunes.js` `CopyBlockTune`, tool key `copyBlockTune`, stores nothing; `editor/block-clipboard.js` writes `application/x-editor-js` `[{ id, tool, data, tunes }]` plus `text/plain` and `text/html` from the shared renderers, never raw HTML or scripts) are pasted by the field itself (`paste.js` option `onEditorBlocks`): other fields, entries and browser tabs keep every block with its data and tunes. Editor.js 2.31 alone (2.4 behaviour) inserted only `tool` and `data` (tunes such as alignment were lost) and only when every block fitted; blocks that do not fit are now left out with a notice and the rest stay blocks. Suggest mode keeps the 2.4 behaviour.

Plan rules (`planReuseInsertion(source, { selected, preset, hasTool, syncedAvailable, existing })`): source blocks are cleaned like a save first (server `cleanEditorValue` with the source preset; admin `prepareEditorValue`); every block gets a fresh id (comments, range comments and suggestions are keyed by block id and never stored in block data, so they stay with the source); reasons `notAllowed` (target preset, `isBlockAllowed`), `unavailable` (the editor has no tool, for example a disabled Settings block), `syncedMissing` (synced source gone or `enabled: false`: no longer offered for insertion), `unfixable`; heading levels and links are fixed like "Fix automatically" (`adjusted`); `maxBlocks` truncates; toggle `items` stay right (`replaceBlocks`); footnote ids already used in the target or repeated get a new id (marker and note stay together); synced blocks stay references; media blocks keep their Media Library file; other data keys of an allowed block are kept. `parseEditorClipboard` reads at most 2 MiB / 1000 blocks.

Source: the stored **draft** ("as last saved"; the dialog says so), never unsaved changes of another tab; `hasPublished` is only reported.

| Method | Path            | Actions | Handler        | Input                                                                                    | Output                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------ | --------------- | ------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/reuse/types`  | access  | `reuse.types`  | no parameters (strict)                                                                   | `{ data: [{ uid, kind, displayName, localized, locales: [{ code, name }] \| null }] }`: `api::` types with an editor field the caller may read and at least one readable entry; locales with a readable entry                                                                                                                   |
| GET    | `/reuse/source` | access  | `reuse.source` | `?uid&documentId&locale&field` (strict; `uid` `api::` only, `field` a path with indices) | `{ data: { uid, documentId, locale, title, status: 'draft', hasPublished, updatedAt, fields: [{ field, fieldKey, preset, blockCount, truncated, blocks }], limited } }`: non-empty editor fields the caller may read (positional fields per entry, `sections.0.body`), at most 200 blocks per field, 50 fields, 2 MiB of blocks |

Access (`services/access.js` `readableDocument` + `canReadField`): Content Manager read on the type, the permission query with its conditions (also locale permissions) on the draft of the document locale, and field-level read permission of each field (`sections.body` inside components, the zone inside dynamic zones); anything missing or denied is 404 (hidden fields are left out of the list, a requested hidden field is 404). Errors: 400 strict validation; 404 also with `reuse.enabled: false`; 429 above `reuse.perMinute` requests per admin and minute (counter `reuse:<adminId>`, shared by all processes). No new permission action. Handlers log nothing; no audit event (read only; the insertion is a normal edit).

| Config            | Default | Bounds    |
| ----------------- | ------- | --------- |
| `reuse.enabled`   | `true`  | boolean   |
| `reuse.perMinute` | 60      | 1 to 1000 |

`GET /config` adds `data.reuse: { enabled }`. Tests: `tests/reuse.test.mjs`, `tests/integration/reuse.test.mjs` (SQLite and PostgreSQL). Editor.js limits: `insertEditorJSData` drops tunes and block ids; the asynchronous Clipboard API cannot write `application/x-editor-js`, so "Copy block" uses a one-off `copy` listener during `document.execCommand('copy')`; Chromium keeps custom clipboard types between tabs of one browser, other applications only get the text and HTML parts.

## Private upload providers and dropped files (2.5)

Private upload providers (roadmap item 6). Read in the installed Strapi 5.61.1 source: `@strapi/upload/dist/server/register.js` (`baseProvider.isPrivate()` false, `getSignedUrl(file)` returns the file), `services/file.js` `signFileUrls(file)` (signs `url` and every format when `file.provider` is the configured provider and `isPrivate()`; flags `isUrlSigned`), `services/extensions/index.js` + `utils.js` `signFileUrlsOnDocumentService` (registered in the upload bootstrap only for private providers: a Document Service middleware that signs media, Rich text and Blocks values of every result and removes signatures from Rich text and Blocks values before `create`/`update`/`clone`; JSON fields such as Magic Editor X values are not looked into), and the upload controllers (admin and Content API sign their answers; `services/upload.js` `upload()` returns the unsigned file).

- Stored shape: every Media Library file slot (`shared/media-urls.mjs` `fileSlots`: image file, gallery images, video file and poster, audio file, text track files and, new in 2.5, the attaches file) keeps the file `id` and `documentId` next to the **unsigned** URL. The attaches policy keeps `id`/`documentId` (additive; schema `data_attaches`, `AttachesData`); `POST /file/upload` answers them too. Bare-URL blocks (simpleImage, personality photo, link previews, embeds) are not Media Library files and are never rewritten.
- `services/media.js` (private providers only; public providers return their input, same object, without a query):
  - `unsignValues(values)`: a slot with a signature trace (query in its URL or a format URL, `isUrlSigned`) or without an id is matched with one `plugin::upload.file` query (`id`, `documentId` or URL without query) and, when the row belongs to the configured provider, gets the row's URL and format URLs and its `id`/`documentId`. A row found by id is used only when its URL is the stored one (a foreign id from copied content never swaps the file).
  - `signValues(values)`: one query for all files of a call, `file.signFileUrls` per distinct row (`MEDIA_SIGN_LIMITS`: 500 files, 8 at a time, cached for the call), writes the signed URL into the slot and the matching formats. Other providers' files and unknown URLs stay as stored.
  - `signUrls(urls, allowRows)` for the admin route, `referencesOf(value)`, `migrateFileIds({ dryRun = true, batchSize })`, `isPrivate()` (asked once per process, like Strapi).
- `utils/media-signing.js` `registerMediaSigning` (bootstrap, only when `isPrivate()`): Document Service middleware that unsigns Magic Editor X values of `create`/`update`/`clone` data and signs the results of `findOne`/`findFirst`/`findMany`/`create`/`update` and the `{ entries }` of `delete`/`clone`/`publish`/`unpublish`/`discardDraft` (fields in components, dynamic zones and populated relations, `walkOutput`). This covers the Content API without `?mex=`, the GraphQL JSON field and every other Document Service reader, except admin requests (`route.info.type === 'admin'`, through `strapi.requestContext`): the Content Manager edit view keeps the stored, unsigned URLs and the editor signs what it shows, so the edit view equals the live collaboration room (signed copies made every media block differ from the room and re-render when a room was joined, which also replaced a block whose picker was open). `services/references.js` `transform` signs its output once more after resolution (`?mex=` and GraphQL `<field>Rendered`/`<field>Resolved`, also expanded synced blocks). Signatures are also removed before version snapshots, templates and synced sources, block suggestions and collaboration room seeds are stored (`unsignStored`); the session-end comparison unsigns the room content first.
- Editor: `GET /config` -> `uploads.privateFiles`. With it, `admin/src/editor/signed-media.js` watches the field (editor and in-field preview) and replaces the URL of every `img`, `video`/`poster`, `audio`, `source`, `track` and attaches link with a fresh signed one (batched, 100 URL bases per request, cached 4 minutes, asked again once when a load fails). Only the displayed attribute changes; tools keep their data. The image routes (`/image/byFile`, `/image/byUrl`, `/media/byUrl`, `/file/upload`) answer signed URLs for display.

| Method | Path                 | Handler            | Policies                                                                                  | Body / answer                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------ | -------------------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| POST   | `/media/signed-urls` | `media.signedUrls` | `admin::isAuthenticatedAdmin` + `admin::hasPermissions` [`plugin::magic-editor-x.access`] | `{ target?: { uid, documentId, locale?, field, fieldKey? }, urls: string[1..100] (http(s) or site-relative, max 2048) }` (strict) -> `{ data: { private, urls: { <url without query>: <signed url> } } }` |

- Permissions (no new RBAC action): a file is signed when the admin may read it in the Media Library (`plugin::upload.read` with its conditions, creator and roles populated, as the upload plugin checks) or when the `target` field's stored draft refers to it (id or URL) and the admin may read that document (`services/access.js` `checkField`, 404 otherwise; checked for every provider). Unknown URLs, other providers' files and refused files are left out of `urls`. 429 above 120 requests per admin and minute (per process). Public providers: `{ private: false, urls: {} }`. `Cache-Control: no-store`; URLs are never logged.
- Migration `2.5.0-media-file-ids` (`services/migrations.js`, runs in bootstrap under the `migrations` lease and only when the provider is private, then recorded once; a host that switches to a private provider later runs it then): `migrateFileIds` pages by id through every content type and component with an editor field (all locales, drafts and published rows, `db.query`), adds `id`/`documentId` to slots without an id by URL (with or without signature) and, for a private provider, replaces stored signed URLs with the row's URL. Each changed row is read again inside a transaction (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on PostgreSQL; SQLite serialises writes) and written with knex only when it still needs the change; 1.x JSON strings are left for their next save. Report (counts only): `{ dryRun, models, scanned, changedValues, linked, unsigned, unmatched, failed }`. Re-run or dry run with the CLI: `npx magic-editor-x media-file-ids [--apply] [--json] [--batch <n>]` (dry run without `--apply`, exit 1 when a row failed).
- Limits: a file replaced in the Media Library (new URL, same id) keeps the stored URL in plain output until the block's file is chosen again (`?mex=` resolution shows the new file); content that reaches the editor unsigned (live room, version, template) loads once without a signature before the refresher replaces it (a 403 in the browser console from the storage host); Editor.js escapes `&` in string data on save (`&amp;` in signed URLs), which the server's URL matching ignores (the query is replaced).

Dropped files (roadmap item 10). Read in the installed source: `@strapi/upload/dist/admin/index.mjs` (`addComponents`: `media-library` = `MediaLibraryPickerDialog`, or `MediaLibraryDialog` with the `useLegacyMediaLibrary` feature flag; `media-library-file-drop-zone` = `EditorFileDropZone`, only without the legacy flag), `components/EditorFileDropZone/EditorFileDropZone.mjs` (props `children`, `disabled`, `allowedTypes`, `onDropFiles(event) => (asset) => void`; uploads to the Media Library root through the upload progress dialog, checks `canCreate`, filters by `allowedTypes` with a notification), `components/AssetPickerDialog/MediaLibraryPickerDialog.mjs` (props `allowedTypes`, `multiple`, `initiallySelectedAssets`, `onClose`, `onSelectAssets`) and the Blocks editor's use (`content-manager/.../BlocksContent.mjs`, `Blocks/Image.mjs` `createDroppedImagesInserter`).

- Picker: the field already opens whatever `media-library` component the host registers (`useStrapiApp(..., s => s.components['media-library'])`), so 5.61 hosts get the new picker and older/legacy hosts the old dialog with the same props; nothing to switch.
- Drop zone: `EditorField` reads `media-library-file-drop-zone` with `useStrapiApp` and wraps the Editor.js holder in `MediaDropArea.jsx` (feature detection, no version check). Enabled when the editor is ready, the field is not read-only (also not in suggest mode or as a live viewer) and the admin may upload (`plugin::upload.assets.create`); `allowedTypes` from `drop-insert.mjs` `dropTypesFor`: `images` with the image block, `videos`/`audios` with their blocks and Media Library read. Each uploaded asset becomes a block (`droppedBlock`: image block data like a picked image, video/audio blocks with the file) after the block under the pointer, or in place of an empty paragraph (`dropPosition`); one undo step per block, collaborators see it, the field becomes dirty. Editor.js takes file drops in the capture phase on its holder (the image tool would upload the file again through `/image/byFile`), so `MediaDropArea` takes file drops on an ancestor in the capture phase and hands the same `DataTransfer` to the drop zone in a new `drop` event (`DragEventInit.dataTransfer`) dispatched on the drop zone's element. File drags over a field that cannot take them are refused (no "no permission" frame on read-only fields). Drags without files (block moves) are untouched. Without the component the wrapper renders the holder only and Editor.js keeps the 2.4 behaviour (dropped images go through the image tool). Keyboard users insert files with the image, gallery, video and audio blocks and the Media Library picker (the drop zone is a pointer gesture).

Tests: `tests/media-25.test.mjs` (URL matching, slots, rewrite identity, service with a fake provider: one query per batch, owned rows only, unsign + ids, `signUrls` permission filter, Document Service middleware, public identity, drop planning, CLI), `tests/integration/private-media.test.mjs` (adapts to the host's provider; with `MEX_UPLOAD=private` on the 2.5 acceptance host it also needs `MEX_DB` and `MEX_HOST_DIR`: raw storage, CLI dry run/apply/re-run).

## Inline formatting: colour tokens, superscript/subscript, inline annotations (2.5)

All off by default; a field turns them on in the Content-Type Builder (advanced settings, section "Extra formatting"). No new routes, permissions or tables; no migration (2.4 content renders byte-identically).

| Field option        | Type    | Effect                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `inlineColors`      | boolean | Inline tool "Colour" (`color$mex`, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+7): a menu with the palette's text colours, highlights and "Remove colour". Needs a configured palette.                                                                     |
| `inlineScript`      | boolean | Tools "Superscript" (`superscript$mex`, Ctrl/Cmd+.) and "Subscript" (`subscript$mex`, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+.); never toggle footnote markers.                                                                                       |
| `inlineAnnotations` | text    | Comma list of annotation names (`abbreviation`, code-registered names). One tool per annotation (`annotation$<name>`; abbreviation Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+9). Definitions whose `presets` include the field's preset are offered too. |

- Config `palette` (`shared/inline-format.mjs`): `{ colors: Token[], highlights: Token[], background?: { light, dark }, text?: { light, dark } }`, `Token = { name (/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/), label? (string or { locale: string }, max 60), light (#rgb/#rrggbb), dark? }`, at most 24 per list, unique names (zod in `config/index.js`). `light`/`dark` are used only for the editor display (admin theme decides) and the contrast check; the site CSS styles the renderer classes. `GET /config` adds `data.palette` (normalised) and `data.annotations` (summaries); `GET /settings` adds `environment.palette` (`issues`, `css`, annotation names) for the read-only section in Settings > Configuration. Bootstrap logs the number of combinations below 4.5:1.
- Stored form: `<span data-mex-color="token">`, `<mark data-mex-highlight="token">`, plain `<sup>`/`<sub>`, `<span data-mex-annotation="name" data-mex-a-<key>="value">` (name /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$/, keys /^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,23}$/, max 8 values of 1000 chars). Never a style. `INLINE_ATTRIBUTES` allow the attributes (sanitize-html prefix wildcard `data-mex-a-*`; admin DOMPurify hook `forceKeepAttr`); `canonicalInlineExtras(html, policy)` validates them.
- Save policy: `inlinePolicy(preset, { palette })` (`shared/presets.mjs`) -> `{ tags, footnotes, colors, highlights, annotations, plainTags }`; `cleanEditorValue(value, { inline })` (`utils/sanitizer.js` `inlineSanitizerForPolicy`, server `utils/inline-policy.js` `fieldInlinePolicy`/`paletteOf`). Used by the Document Service middleware, suggestions, Strapi AI translation guard and synced expansion. Tokens not in the palette, or any token when `inlineColors` is off, are unwrapped (text kept); annotations not enabled or registered, or missing a required value, are unwrapped; values are cleaned by the definition. `footnotes` is now its own rule (a preset with superscript but without the footnote tool keeps plain `<sup>` and removes markers). `plainTags`: tags allowed only in their special form (basic + colours unwraps ordinary `span`/`mark`). The admin keeps every syntactically valid token (the server decides).
- Renderers (`render/inline.mjs`): colour/highlight -> `<span class="mex-color-<t>" data-mex-color="<t>">` / `<mark class="mex-highlight-<t>" data-mex-highlight="<t>">` (HTML, React, Vue); text/Markdown keep the text. Annotations: the definition's `render({ name, attrs, text, resolved })` returns ONE wrapper `{ tag, attrs }` (tags `ANNOTATION_RENDER_TAGS`; attrs title, class, lang, dir, href only on `a` (sanitizeUrl), datetime, value, cite, aria-label, `data-*` except `data-mex-*`), `false` = text only, else default `<span class="mex-annotation mex-annotation-<name>" data-mex-annotation>` (cleaned values only for known definitions). Built-in `abbreviation` -> `<abbr title>`. Options `annotations: [definition]` (replaces the bundle registry for the call), `resolveAnnotation(annotation) -> string|object`.
- Block SDK (`magic-editor-x/blocks`): `defineInlineAnnotation({ name, label?, description?, attributes: { key: { type: text|enum|url, required?, label?, max?, values?, schemes?, relative? } }, presets?, shortcut? (ANNOTATION_SHORTCUTS: CMD+SHIFT+0/1/8), resolve?, render? })`, `annotationJsonSchema(def)`, `abbreviationAnnotation`, constants. Server: `service('blocks').registerInlineAnnotation(def)` in `register()` (`RESERVED_NAME` for `abbreviation`, `NAME_TAKEN`, `REGISTRY_SEALED` after bootstrap), `annotations()`, `annotation(name)`, `annotationSummaries()`; destroy clears. Admin tools are generated from the `GET /config` summaries (`annotationsFromSummaries`): wrap the selection, small form (one input per attribute, primary "Apply", "Remove"), required values checked; a new annotation left without required values is removed when the toolbar closes.
- `resolve(items, { status, find })` (server, `services/references.js` `resolveAnnotations`): one call per definition and response with the distinct uses (max 200, `[{ attrs, locale }]`), result array in the same order (string max 2000 or plain object); inside the 5 s output budget; failures leave the value out. `find(uid, { filters, fields, locale, limit })`: only `api::` types the caller may `find` (users-permissions/API token, same rule as links), query through `contentAPI.sanitize.query` with the caller's auth, request status (published by default), max 100 rows, rows through `sanitize.output`. JSON output (`?mex=json`) keeps the stored form. Example: `tests/fixtures/glossary.mjs`.
- Quality: rule `color-contrast` (warning, `lintDocument` option `palette`, enabled in the editor for fields with `inlineColors`): every used text-colour/highlight pair (default text / page background for the missing side) below 4.5:1 in the light or dark theme, `params: { color, highlight, pair, mode, ratio }`. `paletteContrastIssues(palette)` lists all pairs for Settings.
- Editor: palette CSS injected once by the style owner (`palette-style.mjs`, light or dark values by admin theme, also `.mex-preview` classes). The inline toolbar wraps into rows on narrow screens (global rule; Editor.js measures it outside the editor and sets top and bottom, so `height: max-content`). Editor.js limits: an inline tool method named `clear()` runs on every toolbar close; a MenuConfig `name` must equal the tool key or its shortcut does nothing; a click in a nested menu moves the selection (the colour tool restores it from text offsets); Tab in a block is taken by the indent tune, so inline tools need shortcuts for keyboard use.

## Local drafts and lazy start of fields (2.5)

Two browser-only features of the editor field; no routes, permissions, content types or stored-shape changes. Config keys (`server/src/config/index.js`, returned by `GET /config` as `data.drafts` and `data.lazyInit`):

| Key                 | Default | Meaning                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `drafts.enabled`    | `true`  | Keep unsaved field content in the admin's browser and offer to restore it                         |
| `drafts.ttlHours`   | `72`    | Lifetime of a buffer (1 to 720 hours)                                                             |
| `lazyInit.enabled`  | `true`  | Start Editor.js (and the live room) only when the field nears the viewport, is focused or clicked |
| `lazyInit.marginPx` | `800`   | Distance in CSS px above and below the viewport at which a field starts (0 to 10000)              |

Local draft buffer (roadmap item 7; `admin/src/editor/drafts-logic.mjs` pure rules, `draft-store.js` IndexedDB, `components/EditorField/useDraftBuffer.js`, `DraftNotice.jsx`; tests `tests/drafts.test.mjs`):

- Storage: IndexedDB database `magic-editor-x`, store `drafts` (keyPath `id`). Not sessionStorage (lost when the tab is closed, the most common loss) and not localStorage (about 5 MB per origin shared with the admin token, synchronous writes while typing). Without IndexedDB nothing is buffered and nothing breaks.
- Id: `<admin user id>|<uid>|<documentId or "new">|<locale or "-">|<field identity>`; identity = path, or `<base path>#<fieldKey>` for a positional field whose key is saved (`draftIdentity`).
