New entries (no documentId) are keyed by content type, locale and field. Record `{ v: 1, id, baseHash, savedAt, expiresAt, data }`; `data` is the normalised Editor.js document without `fieldKey`; `baseHash` is a 64-bit FNV-style hash of the saved value's fingerprint when the buffer was written; content above 6 MiB of JSON is not buffered.
- Write rule (`bufferAction`): debounced (800 ms) and at once on `pagehide`, `visibilitychange` hidden and unmount, only while the field's form value differs from its saved value (Content Manager form `initialValues`; for a keyed positional field the saved entry with that key, `savedValueOf`). Otherwise the field's own buffer is deleted (after Save, after undoing every change). Live collaboration that is `live` with nothing `pending` never buffers (the room persists the content) and deletes the field's buffer; `connecting`, `syncing`, `reconnecting`, `offline` or unsent edits buffer (the offline gap).
- Restore (`restoreDecision`): when the editor is ready (and a live room has synced), a valid, unexpired buffer that differs from what the editor shows and from the saved value shows one notice in the field (between the toolbar and the editor, `data-testid="mex-draft-notice"`): "Unsaved changes from <relative time> were found." with **Restore** (primary, `mex-draft-restore`) and **Discard** (`mex-draft-discard`). Never restored automatically. When `baseHash` no longer matches the saved value, `data-conflict="true"` and a second sentence says the saved content changed and how many blocks differ (`summarizeDiff`). Restore goes through `replaceContent` (form dirty, live room updated, one undo step). Buffers equal to the shown or saved content, expired or unreadable ones are deleted; read-only fields show nothing and keep the buffer. Until the notice is answered, the field does not write its buffer.
- Removal: Save (clean again), Discard, TTL (`pruneDrafts` once per page load, and on opening), voluntary logout: a Redux middleware (`app.addMiddlewares`, installed `@strapi/admin` 5.61.1 `StrapiApp.addMiddlewares`, entries are factories) sees the RTK Query mutation `logout` (`adminApi/executeMutation/pending`, `meta.arg.endpointName === 'logout'`) followed by `admin/logout` within 60 s and clears every buffer of every admin in this browser. An ended session (`admin/logout` after a refused refresh, Strapi's "Session ended" dialog) keeps the buffers so the work can be restored after logging in again (they belong to that admin id and expire with the TTL).
- Privacy: content stays in that admin's browser profile (IndexedDB, not encrypted) until saved, discarded, expired or the admin logs out; other admins in the same browser never see it in the UI (id contains the admin id) but anyone with access to the browser profile can read it. Owners who do not want this set `drafts.enabled: false`.
- Session-expiry warning: built in 2.6 from the requests' answers, not from a countdown; see "Signed out: session-expiry detection and recovery (2.6)".

Lazy start (roadmap item 8; `admin/src/editor/lazy-init.mjs`, `components/EditorField/useLazyActivation.js`, `LazyPlaceholder.jsx`):

- A Content Manager field (uid set; never the template editor) whose frame is farther than `marginPx` from the viewport on its first layout does not create Editor.js; an IntersectionObserver (`rootMargin` `marginPx` above and below) starts it. Fields in or near the viewport start before the first paint as before. Fields in collapsed repeatable components and dynamic zone items are not mounted by the Content Manager; expanding one mounts it in view, so it starts at once.
- Until ready, the field shows its toolbar (disabled tools) and a static render of the saved value (React renderer, lazy images, embeds as placeholders) with the field's min height (`data-testid="mex-lazy-placeholder"`, a tab stop with `aria-busy`); the holder renders out of view (`position: absolute; visibility: hidden`) and replaces the placeholder when ready. Focusing (Tab) or clicking the placeholder starts the editor and moves the focus into it.
- The live room starts with the editor (`useCollaboration` waits for `ready`), so a waiting field opens no socket. Form value, validation, publish guard, comments polling and history are unchanged: the form keeps the saved value until the person edits.
- Tests: `data-mex-ready="true"` keeps its meaning (Editor.js ready and every listener attached). A waiting field has no `data-mex-ready`; scroll it into view (`locator.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()`) or focus its placeholder before waiting for it, or set `lazyInit.enabled: false` on a test host. The frame carries `data-mex-frame="true"`. Browser tests of the offline gap: Chromium's offline emulation (`context.setOffline`) does not close an established WebSocket, so the room keeps receiving edits and correctly nothing is buffered; cut the live sockets (Playwright `page.routeWebSocket`, refusing new ones during the gap) to test a real gap. A suite that opens many entries as one admin exceeds `collaboration.rateLimit.sessionsPerMinute` (60, answered 429 and retried with backoff), so test hosts raise it.
- Measured (Chromium 1440 x 900, SQLite host, entry with 20 top-level fields and a dynamic zone with 5 items): see the 2.5 acceptance notes; the 2.4 behaviour opened one Editor.js and one live room per mounted field, and above `collaboration.maxRoomsPerAdmin` (20) further rooms are refused and retried.

## Signed out: session-expiry detection and recovery (2.6)

Browser only; no routes, permissions, config keys or stored-shape changes. Files: `admin/src/editor/session-guard.mjs` (pure rules and the tab's guard), `admin/src/utils/fetch-client.js`, `admin/src/editor/useSessionGuard.js`, `admin/src/components/EditorField/SessionBanner.jsx`; tests `tests/session-guard.test.mjs`.

What Strapi 5.62 does (installed `@strapi/admin` source): `getFetchClient` retries a 401 once after `POST /admin/access-token` (`withTokenRefresh`); a refused refresh throws the original 401. RTK Query requests (the Content Manager's own save and reads) then call `triggerSessionExpired`, and `AuthProvider.handleSessionDead` logs the tab out: with a dirty form (`registerUnsavedChangesCheck`) after its "Session ended" dialog, otherwise at once, and navigates to `/auth/login` without `redirectTo` (measured: a Save with a dead session lands on the login page at once and, after signing in, on `/admin`; form state is gone). `useSessionKeepalive` renews while the admin is active and reports a refused renewal the same way. When another tab stores a new token (`establishAdminSession` broadcasts on `strapi-admin-session`), `reconcileSharedSession` adopts it, closes a pending "Session ended" dialog and clears the admin API cache, so the edit view reloads the entry and the form is reset to the saved values. Access tokens are only valid while their session row (`strapi_sessions`) is active (`strategies/admin.js` `isSessionActive`).

Detection (`sessionGuard`, one per tab; state `active` | `ended` | `loggedOut`, `endedAt`, `resumedAt`, `generation`): `ended` on the first of

- a plugin request that fails with 401 (or `TokenRefreshError`) after Strapi's refresh: every plugin request goes through `utils/fetch-client.js`, a wrapper of Strapi's `useFetchClient`/`getFetchClient` that reports the error and rethrows it (no global `fetch` patching; only the status is read). 400, 403, 404, 409, 429, 5xx, network errors and aborted requests do not count;
- a rejected RTK Query action with `payload.status === 401` in the admin store (`createSessionGuardMiddleware`, `app.addMiddlewares`), except the auth endpoints (`login`, `logout`, `register*`, `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword`, ...);
- `admin/logout` without the admin's own `logout` mutation in the 60 s before (an ended session). With it, the state is `loggedOut` (no banner).

`active` again on `admin/login` or `admin/setToken` with a token (signed in here, or adopted from another tab). Repeated reports while `ended` only count (`reports`): one transition, one banner.

While `ended`:

- **Banner** (`SessionBanner`, `data-testid="mex-session-banner"`, `data-state` `ended` | `resumed` | `idle`): every Content Manager field mounts it, only the leader renders it (`sessionGuard.claimLeader`, first mounted field; the next one takes over when it unmounts), as a portal at the bottom of the viewport (`zIndices.notification`, above the full-screen editor), lifted above a bar fixed at the bottom of the page (Strapi's Save/Publish bar below 768 px, measured with `elementsFromPoint` while shown and on resize). Text in a `role="status"` `aria-live="polite"` region that exists before it fills; focus is never moved. "You were signed out." / "Your changes are kept on this device. Sign in again to save." and one button **Sign in again** (`mex-session-sign-in`, visually hidden "(opens a new tab)"). After signing in: "You are signed in again. Save the entry to keep your changes." for 10 s.
- **Sign in again** opens `<admin base>/auth/login` in a tab named `magic-editor-x-sign-in` (`window.open`, opener kept, same origin). This page stays open. That tab's `createSignInTabCloser` middleware closes it 800 ms after `admin/login` (after Strapi told the other tabs). A blocked pop-up shows "Your browser blocked the new tab." with a link to the sign-in page (`mex-session-link`). Measured: the new tab first finds the dead token, Strapi logs it out and shows the login form; meanwhile the entry tab may show Strapi's own "Session ended" dialog (dirty form), which Strapi closes when the new token arrives. Confirming that dialog instead logs the entry tab out: the buffers stay and the entry offers them (below).
- **No storm**: collaboration clients are paused (`collab-client.js` `pause()`: socket closed, no reconnects or token requests, status `paused`, edits kept pending; a token request answered 401 pauses the client by itself); presence heartbeats, comment, suggestion, widget and synced-source polling and the panel's focus reload stop (`useSessionActive` in their effects); the panel's leave request is skipped. Measured (SQLite, revoked session, entry with four editor fields and collaboration on): one plugin request (the detecting presence heartbeat, so the banner appears within one 15 s heartbeat) and one refresh attempt from the end until 30 s after the banner, against 17 requests in 30 s on 2.5.2 (comments and suggestions every 5 s, 4 refresh attempts).
- **Drafts**: `bufferAction({ sessionEnded: true })` writes a changed field at once (0 ms after the end, then 800 ms debounce) and on every change, also in a live room, and never deletes (`keep`).

After signing in again (`resumedAt`):

- Collaboration resumes 1.5 s later (a field unmounted by Strapi's reload would otherwise close a connecting socket) with a fresh token and sends pending edits.
- **Recovery** (`recoveryAction`, `autoRestoreOnOpen`, `onRecover(data, { remounted })` in `EditorField/index.jsx`):
  - Without a live room: a field that stayed mounted and whose form value falls back to the saved value within 15 s gets its last buffer back (`replaceContent`: form dirty, one undo step) only when the saved value is still the one the buffer was based on (`lastWrittenRef.baseKey`, `recoveryAction` `draftBaseKey`); if someone saved meanwhile (or the base is unknown) the Restore/Discard notice with the conflict counts is shown instead (2.6 review); a field that mounts anew within 15 s (Strapi reloaded the edit view) restores a buffer written after `endedAt` without asking when it has no conflict with the saved value.
  - In a live room nothing is replaced, because others may have edited meanwhile (measured before this rule: replacing the room with the buffer deleted a collaborator's sentence typed while the first admin was signed out). A field that stayed mounted still shows the text and its paused client sends it, so only the form gets the editor content again. A remounted field merges the buffered edit onto the room: `pause()` keeps the acknowledged room content (`pausedBase()`, held in memory by room key in `useCollaboration` until a remounted field takes it), and `mergeLocal(pausedBase, buffer)` applies only the difference (`replica.rebase`, after the room was rendered). Without a base the notice is shown.
  - A found buffer is compared with what the field shows only once the field settled: not while its room is `connecting` or `syncing`, and in a live room only after the editor rendered the room (`roomRendered`); before 2.6 a field could decide against the saved value while its room was still being created. Fingerprints treat default tune values as no tune (`comparableBlocks`) and `&nbsp;`/U+00A0 as a space, so a buffer equal to the room is deleted instead of offered.
  - Any other buffer keeps the notice (Restore/Discard). Buffers are not deleted until the recovery decided, then as before (Save, Discard, TTL).
- **Coming back without a new token**: a plugin request sent after the end that succeeds resumes (`reportSuccess`, e.g. the 401 was not about the session, or the admin signed in where this tab does not hear it); the banner's leader sends one `GET /config` when the tab gets focus or becomes visible, at most every 10 s, while signed out.
- Voluntary logout still clears every buffer (unchanged `createLogoutMiddleware`); an involuntary end never does.

Privacy and security: nothing new is stored; the buffers are the existing 2.5 drafts (IndexedDB, this admin's browser). The guard keeps a status, two times and a source word in memory; it reads no token, body, cookie or storage (source test) and logs nothing. Server side (2.6): a collaboration socket ends with its admin session (see Collaboration protocol, item 7): edits arriving after the end are refused with `SESSION_ENDED` within at most 5 s, and the client then pauses and reports the end to the guard (`onSessionEnded`).

Tests: `tests/session-guard.test.mjs` (which responses count, one transition, pause/resume, voluntary vs involuntary logout and drafts, buffering while signed out, recovery rules, middleware, leader, admin base path, sign-in tab closer, collaboration client pause/resume and 401 on the token request). Browser: `accept.mjs` on the session acceptance host (revoked `strapi_sessions` rows, and a 401 route mock), see the 2.6 acceptance notes.

## Deferred from 2.5 and dependency notes (2.5)

- Component blocks (roadmap item 3) are not in 2.5. Branch `feat/2.5-components` (pushed, not merged) has the block `component` (`{ uid, values, _mex: 1 }`, field option `allowedComponents`, scalar attributes only, server validation, renderer option `componentBlocks`, Yjs mapping). A two-editor stress test (`pw/repro-stress.mjs` on the agent host, CPU throttled 4x) lost a collaborator's edit: the form sent all values per keystroke and overwrote values that had reached the block but were not drawn yet (3/8 rounds, different attributes; 1/4 rounds, same attribute). Fix on the branch: per-attribute patches (`mergeComponentPatch`) and text edits replayed on the latest text (`rebaseTextEdit`), with regression tests. Before merging: rerun the stress test on the final build, `s-components` 5x SQLite + 1x PostgreSQL, and the cluster proof with 0 lost edits.
- Live Preview (item 4): done as far as Strapi allows in 2.6 (section "Live Preview: block attributes and click-to-locate (2.6)"). The columns block (item 13) shipped in 2.6 as a constrained cell model (see "Columns block (2.6)").
- `@editorjs/embed` is pinned to `~2.7.7` (2.8.0 declares `engines.node >=24`). `admin/src/editor/tools/embed-services.mjs` defines YouTube (with Shorts) and Figma (document URLs only) as custom services in the tool's `services` config; stored embed blocks are unchanged. `engines.node` is `>=22.12.0 <=26.x.x` (sanitize-html 2.18 needs 22.12). `tests/engines.test.mjs` fails when a production dependency in the lockfile refuses the oldest supported Node; CI installs the packed package on Node 22 and fails on EBADENGINE.
- Dev dependencies follow Strapi 5.62: `@strapi/strapi` and `@strapi/utils` ^5.62.0, `@strapi/design-system` and `@strapi/icons` ^2.3.1 (peer ranges unchanged: ^2.2.0 and ^5.38.0).

## Component blocks (2.6)

Content-Type Builder components as blocks inside a Magic Editor X field. Off by default: a field shows component blocks only when its option lists components. No new routes, permissions, config keys or tables; `GET /config` gains `data.components`.

| Part                 | Contract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Field option         | `options.allowedComponents`: comma-separated component uids (`category.name`, max 50, `parseComponentList`). Empty = no component blocks. Independent of the preset block list (any preset), not part of `preset.restricted`. CTB input type `magic-editor-x-allowed-components` (registered in admin `bootstrap` through `app.getPlugin('content-type-builder').apis.forms.components.add`), a multi-select fed by `GET /content-type-builder/components`; components that cannot be used are listed with the reason.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Stored block         | `{ type: 'component', data: { uid, values, _mex: 1 } }`. `uid` valid or `''`; `values`: at most 50 keys `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/` (no prototype keys) with plain-text strings (max 20000), finite numbers or booleans; attributes without a value are left out; never HTML. `_mex` is the built-in marker and the shape version (`MARKED_BLOCKS.component`, anchor `uid` string). A Settings custom block named `component` from before 2.6 keeps its data (`LEGACY_BUILT_IN_NAMES`, admin `LEGACY_NAMES`); the block SDK keeps the name open (`SDK_COMPATIBLE_NAMES`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Supported attributes | `string`, `text`, `richtext` (plain text), `email`, `enumeration`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `datetime` (ISO, stored UTC), `time` (`HH:mm:ss.SSS`), `integer`, `biginteger` (string), `float`, `decimal`, `boolean`. Rules honoured: `required`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `min`, `max`, `regex`, `enum`, `default` (new blocks). Hidden attributes (`id`, timestamps, `visible: false`) are skipped. Any other attribute (media, relation, component, dynamic zone, JSON, password, uid, blocks, custom field), a private attribute (`private: true` or `api.responses.privateAttributes`, server via `contentTypes.isPrivateAttribute`) or more than 50 attributes make the component unsupported: it cannot be selected and existing blocks are read-only. Media, relations and nested components were left out: they need permission checks, population and sanitising per caller.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Descriptor           | `shared/components.mjs` `describeComponent(uid, schema, { isPrivate? })` -> `{ uid, displayName, category, icon, fields: [{ name, type, required, minLength?, maxLength?, min?, max?, regex?, enum?, default? }], unsupported: [{ name, type, reason: type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | private | name | enum | tooMany }], supported }`; `GET /config` `data.components` lists every component (schema only, no content). |
| Save                 | Document Service middleware (`utils/component-blocks.js` `createComponentChecker`, every writer): uid not in the field's list -> `COMPONENT_NOT_ALLOWED` (restricted fields report it through `checkPreset`); unsupported -> `COMPONENT_UNSUPPORTED`; otherwise `checkComponentValues` against the current `strapi.components[uid]`: unknown attributes dropped, values coerced (numeric strings, `'true'`/`'false'`, dates and times to Strapi formats), each broken rule -> `COMPONENT_INVALID` `params: { uid, field, rule }` (rule names only, never values). All in `ValidationError` `details.code: 'PRESET_VIOLATION'`. A listed uid that no longer exists (component deleted in the CTB) keeps its stored values unchecked.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Live rooms           | Generic Yjs mapping (`values` is a Y.Map, strings Y.Text), so concurrent edits of different attributes merge. Guard (`ydoc-guard.mjs` `validComponentData`): only `uid`, `values`, `_mex`; scalar values within the limits, else `INVALID_BLOCK`. A changed `data.uid` (map key or text) is structural, so the preset rule runs; so is adding or removing any key of a component block's data (2.6 review: deleting an extra key turned custom data into a built-in component with a disallowed uid; `touchedBy` reports `dataKeys`); the collaboration service checks component blocks in every field (also unrestricted ones). `apply-remote.js` applies a collaborator's value change in place (`applyComponentValues`), so the local editor keeps focus. The form sends only the attribute it changed; the tool merges it into the block's current values (`mergeComponentPatch`), so a collaborator's change that arrived before the form re-rendered is never overwritten (2.5 regression: a whole-values write from a stale render deleted it). Edits typed while a room snapshot is applied (2.6): the tool keeps `synced` (the room's values, from the constructor, `markComponentsPushed` after every `pushLocal` and each snapshot); `applyComponentValues(id, data, { keepPending: true })` merges local edits that differ from `synced` onto the snapshot (`mergePendingValues`, text through `rebaseTextEdit`, which never drops an insertion), the field records `componentRoomView(shown)` as the diff base and calls `reportUnpushedComponents()` so they are pushed. History restores and form resets (`live` false) replace the values. Limit: when two people type in the same attribute at the same time, both texts are kept (Yjs text merge) but the caret of the local editor jumps to the end of that input, because a controlled input moves the caret when its value is replaced. |
| Output               | Content API `?mex=` and GraphQL (`references.transform`, `createComponentOutput`): blocks of removed or unsupported components are left out (enclosing toggles shortened), only attributes the current schema has are kept. The plain REST answer and raw GraphQL fields get the same filter (2.6 review, `utils/component-read.js`: Document Service middleware on `findOne`/`findFirst`/`findMany` inside a request with route type `content-api`; admin and internal reads and write answers are unchanged; values without component blocks are the same object).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Renderers            | Default: nothing (HTML, tree, React, Vue, text, Markdown). Option `componentBlocks: { [uid]: (block, helpers) => nodes \| string }` used like `overrides` (validated by `cleanOverrideNodes`); `overrides.component` wins. React `components.component` / Vue slot `block-component` receive every component block (an empty wrapper node without separator). Text/Markdown: `overrides.component`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Other                | Find and replace: string/text/richtext values of components known to the admin bundle (`setActiveComponents` from `GET /config`). Diff: `uid` value, values plain text. AI segments: none (values are not inline HTML).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Admin                | Toolbox (+) / slash menu: one entry per allowed, supported component (display name, generic component icon; Strapi does not export its component icon map). Form (`ComponentBlockView`, portal into the block like synced blocks): DS TextInput/Textarea/NumberInput/SingleSelect/Switch (native `date`/`time`/`datetime-local` inputs), rules checked while typing (errors after leaving a field or the block), Enter in a one-line input never submits the entry form, keys/paste stay in the form. Removed, not allowed or unsupported components: read-only notice, values kept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## Live Preview: block attributes and click-to-locate (2.6)

Research record: `docs/live-preview.md` (Strapi 5.62.0 docs, installed source and 5.61.1 diff, GitHub). Front-end guide: `docs/guides/live-preview.md`. Facts that drive the design (installed `@strapi/content-manager` / `@strapi/core` 5.62.0, unchanged from 5.61.1 unless noted): the preview script highlights every element with `data-strapi-source`; `strapiFieldChange` is public, the admin sends it for every field change (`{ field, value, type }`, `type: 'json'` and the whole Editor.js object for Magic Editor X); for non-Blocks values the script sets `textContent = String(value)` on every element whose source contains `path=<field>` (measured: "[object Object]"), Blocks values are forwarded; content source maps encode string values only (`json` objects skipped); `INTERNAL_EVENTS` (focus intent, single-click hint, ...) and `usePreviewPopoverBlockIndex` are not public; `InputPopover` (double-click) is not license-gated in the code and opened the whole Magic Editor X field on the community host, but Strapi documents double-click editing as Live Preview (Growth/Enterprise, experimental), so nothing here depends on it; the side editor is gated by `cms-advanced-preview`.

- **Renderer option `blockIds`** (`shared/render/source.mjs`, applied in `render/tree.mjs` `createTreeBuilder` to the top-level `{ type: 'block' }` wrappers, so HTML, `renderTree`, React and Vue match): `true` -> `data-mex-block-id="<block id>"` on each element node of each top-level block; `{ field, strapiSource? }` adds `data-mex-field-path="<field>"` and, with `strapiSource: { documentId, model, kind?, locale? }`, `data-strapi-source="documentId=…&type=json&model=…[&kind=…][&locale=…]&fieldPath=<field>"` (encodeURIComponent, Strapi's key order, **no `path` key**, see above). Patterns: block id `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` (the renderer replaces invalid stored ids before rendering), field path `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,99}(\.(\d{1,6}|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,99})){0,19}$` (≤ 300 chars), documentId `^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,64}$`, model `(api|plugin)::name.name`, kind `collectionType|singleType`, locale BCP 47-like; invalid parts are left out, never an error. Off by default (`undefined`, `false`, arrays, functions, other values): output byte-identical (`tests/preview-26.test.mjs`). Elements are copied, nested blocks (toggle children) are not marked, raw HTML from string overrides cannot be marked, custom React/Vue `components` that drop the default output lose the attributes. `data-mex-field-path` (not `data-mex-field`, which custom blocks already use for their fields).
- **Content API**: `?mex=html&mexBlockIds=true|false` (registered with `addQueryParams` next to `mex`, other values 400 `ValidationError` `details.param: 'mexBlockIds'`, ignored for other formats and without `mex`). `walkOutput` passes `{ path, entry }` to its visitor: `path` relative to the entry (`body`, `sections.1.body`, `zone.0.body`; populated relations start a new entry), `entry` `{ documentId, model, kind, locale }`. `render-output.js` sets `item.render.blockIds = { field: path }` and, when the request has Strapi's `strapi-encode-source-maps: true` header, `strapiSource: entry`; `references.transform` passes `render.blockIds` to the HTML renderer only. GraphQL unchanged (Strapi's source maps are REST only too).
- **Click-to-locate** (`shared/preview-locate.mjs`, admin `EditorField` + `editor/frame-source.mjs`): URL `?mexField=<path>&mexBlock=<id>` (exactly one `mexField`, at most one `mexBlock`, search ≤ 4096 chars) read once when the field mounts; message `{ type: 'magic-editor-x:locate', field, blockId }` accepted only when `event.source` is the `contentWindow` of an iframe in the admin document (`isEmbeddedFrameWindow`), answered with `{ type: 'magic-editor-x:located', field }` to `event.source`/`event.origin`. The field whose `target.field` equals the path starts (lazy start), blurs a focused iframe, then `selectBlock` (scroll + caret); unknown block -> scroll the field into view and an info toast `editor.locate.missing` (5 locales); suggest mode defers. Nothing is stored or sent to the server. Fields not mounted (collapsed repeatable components, dynamic zone entries) do nothing.
- **Front-end helpers** in `magic-editor-x/render` (`types/render.d.ts`): `editViewUrl(...)` (http/https admin URL, `collection-types/<uid>/<documentId>` or `single-types/<uid>`, `plugins[i18n][locale]`), `locateMessage`, `requestLocate({ field, blockId, adminOrigin, timeoutMs = 400 (50..5000) })` (posts to `window.parent` with the admin origin, resolves `true` on a `located` answer from the parent with that origin), `isBlockId`, `isFieldPath`, `strapiSourceValue`, `LOCATE_MESSAGE_TYPE`, `LOCATED_MESSAGE_TYPE`.
- Measured on the 5.62.0 community host (Chromium 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844, light and dark): preview click on a block -> edit view with the caret in block 19 of a lazily started field in 1.8-1.9 s; a locate message from an iframe in the edit view (side-editor stand-in) -> caret in the block without navigation; a message posted by the page itself ignored; missing block -> notice; double-click popover typing with `fieldPath`-only sources kept the rendered blocks, with `path=` they became "[object Object]"; the example front end re-rendered the field from `strapiFieldChange` while typing; 0 Magic Editor X console messages. Not tested: the licensed side editor.

## Core Blocks bridge (2.7)

Lets custom block types of Strapi's core `blocks` field (Content Manager `addRichTextBlocks`) pass Strapi's server validation, which rejects unknown node types with "Block node is of invalid type" (`@strapi/core` `services/entity-validator/blocks-validator`, unchanged 5.38 to 5.63; RFC https://github.com/strapi/strapi/discussions/25546). Off by default.

- Server API: `strapi.plugin('magic-editor-x').service('core-blocks')`: `register({ type, validator, plugin? })` (type `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, max 64, not a built-in node type `paragraph|heading|quote|list|list-item|image|code|text|link`, one owner, max 100; validator = Yup schema (`__isYupSchema__`) or `(helpers) => schema` called once; helpers `{ yup, textNodeValidator, linkNodeValidator, inlineNodeValidator, checkValidLink }` mirror Strapi's and match the RFC names; throws `CoreBlockDefinitionError` with `code` `INVALID_DEFINITION|INVALID_TYPE|BUILTIN_TYPE|TYPE_TAKEN|INVALID_VALIDATOR|TOO_MANY_TYPES`), `list()`, `status()` (`{ enabled, configEnabled, source: 'settings'|'config', state: 'off'|'idle'|'active'|'native'|'unavailable', reason, types, claimedByStrapi }`), `start()` (bootstrap), `setEnabled(boolean)` (settings update; `true` always re-runs the canary), `settled()` (queued changes and probes done), `stop()` (destroy, async: sets `stopped`, cancels queued `apply()`s, awaits the in-flight one; nothing installs a wrapper after it, because `strapi.entityValidator` is shared by every Strapi instance of the process). Registration works at any time; a type registered while the bridge is installed is probed first and is not bridged until then.
- Wrapper (`utils/core-blocks-bridge.js`): replaces `validateEntityCreation` and `validateEntityUpdate` on `strapi.entityValidator` (the object the Document Service calls; tagged with `Symbol.for('magic-editor-x.coreBlocksBridge')`, never stacked, restored by `stop`). Per write: collect top-level nodes of `blocks` attributes (also in components, repeatable components, dynamic zones) whose `type` is registered; check limits (`LIMITS`: depth 32, 10000 values, 256 KiB characters per node, 1000 custom nodes per write; plain JSON only; no `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` keys); validate a `structuredClone` with the registered schema (`strict: true`, `abortEarly: false`); replace each node with a paragraph carrying a random marker; call Strapi's original; merge Strapi's and the custom errors into one `ValidationError` (`details.errors` with paths like `['body','1','tone']`, message `N errors occurred` for several); on success put the original node objects back at their paths (copy-on-write, caller data never mutated). A missing marker in Strapi's result rejects the write (`RESTORE_FAILED`). Inactive or empty registry: straight pass-through.
- Gate: `apply()` (bootstrap, switch, 30 s store refresh) returns early after `stop()`; an off-to-on transition (and every `setEnabled(true)`) resets the canary and the type probes; it checks native support first (`strapi.customBlocks.register` or container `custom-blocks`: no wrapper, registrations forwarded with native helpers merged over ours, state `native`, one info log), then the hook point (`checkHookPoint`: writable, configurable own functions) and once the canary (`runCanary` with an in-memory model on `admin::user`: paragraph passes, random probe type rejected at its path). Failure: state `unavailable`, one error log, no wrapper. Then every registered type is probed (`isUnknownToStrapi`): only types Strapi rejects with exactly "Block node is of invalid type" at the node's path are bridged; others are left to Strapi (`claimedByStrapi`, one warn log per type, shown in Settings). The wrapper sees only probed, unknown types (`activeView`). Never throws.
- Settings: `GET /settings` `data.coreBlocks` = `status()`; `PUT /settings` optional `coreBlocks: z.strictObject({ enabled: z.boolean() })`, stored in the plugin store `settings.coreBlocks`, applied in this process at once (`setEnabled`). The admin sends it only when the switch changed (`toPayload(draft, saved)`). Section `CoreBlocksSection.jsx` (switch, status badge per state, server types, editor-only warning from `coreBlockCoverage`, links to the README anchor `#core-blocks-bridge` and the RFC).
- Admin helper: `app.getPlugin('magic-editor-x').apis.addCoreBlocks({ [type]: block })` (`admin/src/editor/core-blocks.js`, logic in `core-blocks-logic.mjs`): checks keys (same pattern, not a server built-in or a Blocks editor built-in key such as `heading-one` or `list-ordered`), `renderElement` required, `icon` and `label` when `isInBlocksSelector`; defaults `matchNode` to `node.type === key`; calls `addRichTextBlocks`; returns `false` with one `console.error` when it is missing (Strapi before 5.46). Throws `CoreBlockEditorError`.
- Audit: `settings.update` records `meta.keys` and, when the body has `coreBlocks.enabled`, `meta.coreBlocks: 'on'|'off'`; the audit page shows it.
- Schemas in docs and examples end with `.noUnknown()`; hosts must validate every key their renderer reads.
- Tests: `tests/core-blocks.test.mjs` (real `@strapi/core` entity validator loaded by path; `review 1-4` regressions), `tests/core-blocks-settings.test.mjs`, `tests/admin/core-blocks.test.jsx` (audit text), `tests/core-blocks-host/host.test.mjs` (programmatic Strapi boot under `.tmp/`, needs the build and a built better-sqlite3). `npm run test:core-blocks`; CI job `core-blocks` on 5.38.0 and the newest 5.x.

## Readability and SEO hints, one-click Fix (2.9)

- `shared/content-insights.mjs` (pure, no dependencies): `INSIGHT_RULES` (`reading-ease`, `sentence-long`, `paragraph-long`, `passive-voice`, `complex-words`, `repeated-starts`, `extra-spaces` in section `readability`; `h1-in-content`, `h1-missing`, `section-long`, `internal-links`, `content-short`, `keyphrase-intro`, `keyphrase-headings`, `keyphrase-density` in section `seo`), every finding `{ rule, section, severity: 'hint', blockId|null, blockIndex (-1 = document), path?, params? }`. `INSIGHT_SETTINGS` are the switch names (one per rule, `h1` and `keyphrase` cover several); `BLOCKABLE_SETTINGS` excludes the heuristics (`passive-voice`, `complex-words`, `reading-ease`) and `keyphrase`. Thresholds and sources are in the module header and the README (Yoast scoring docs; Flesch 1948, Amstad 1978, Szigriszt-Pazos 1993 with INFLESZ; Gunning 1952). Accessibility rules (`heading-order`, `multiple-h1`, `image-alt-missing`, `ambiguous-link-text`) are never repeated here.
- Prose units (`insightUnits`): paragraph, quote, header, list and checklist items, warning/alert message, columns items; `linkTool`/`button` URLs count for internal links only. Tables, captions, code and custom blocks are not prose. `analyzeUnit` is cached per language, kind and HTML (`createInsightsCache`, 20,000 entries). `lintInsights(data, { language, settings, keyphrase, rules })` runs everything at once (server); `createInsightsRunner({ schedule, cancel, now, budgetMs })` analyses in slices (the editor: `requestIdleCallback`, 8 ms) and a new `run` cancels the previous one. Word counts for `content-short` use `computeStats` (same number as the toolbar).
- Language: `insightLanguage(locale)` (en, de, fr, es, pt; else null = language-independent rules only); the editor uses the content locale, else the admin locale; the publish guard uses `document.locale`.
- Settings (`server/src/services/settings.js`): optional `contentChecks: { enabled, h1: 'title'|'content', disabled: string[], blockPublish: string[], minWords 0-20000, minInternalLinks 0-50, sentenceWords 0-100 (0 = language default), paragraphWords 20-2000, sectionWords 50-5000 }` (strict zod; omitted keeps the stored value; `normalizeContentChecks` on read). `GET /settings` returns `data.contentChecks`; `GET /config` returns it as `data.quality.contentChecks`. Settings > Configuration section "Readability and SEO hints" (`ContentChecksSection.jsx`, `contentChecksForm.mjs`), saved with the page's Save.
- Field option `disableContentChecks` (checkbox): no hints in that field's panel, skipped by the guard.
- Publish guard: `blockingIssues(strapi, contentType, documents, contentChecks)` adds hints of `blockPublish` rules (with `enabled`) for fields with `publishGuard` and without `disableContentChecks`, as `{ field, rule, blockId|null, locale? }`; the settings are read on each publish (a read failure adds nothing).
- Admin: `QualityPanel` (DS `Accordion` sections Accessibility, Readability, SEO structure with a count `Badge`; one open at a time; Accessibility opens when it has errors), `QualityLinks` (link and scheduled check), `quality-messages.js`, `quality-ui.js`, `useContentInsights` (only while the panel is open; 300 ms debounce). The focus keyphrase (max 100 characters) is stored in `localStorage` under `magic-editor-x:keyphrase:<uid>|<documentId>|<locale>|<field or #fieldKey>` (try/catch; unsaved entries keep it in memory); it never leaves the browser.
- Fixes (`components/EditorField/quality-fixes.mjs`): `fixActionOf(issue, { headingLevels })` -> `heading` (`heading-order`, `multiple-h1`, `h1-in-content`; `headingFixLevel` stays within the allowed levels, else no fix), `typography` (`extra-spaces`; `fixTypography` changes text nodes outside code, kbd, math and footnotes and serialises with `nodesToHtml(..., { storage: true })`), `linkText` (selects the first ambiguous link of the block and shows a prompt; nothing is written), `alt` (focuses the n-th `.mex-alt__input` of the block). `EditorField.updateBlockStep(blockId, transform)` is shared with the grammar "Fix"/"Apply": it saves pending typing, `undo.checkpoint()` and `collab.stopCapturing()` before and after, reads the block fresh, `editor.blocks.update`, then saves at once, so a fix is one undo step and a live room gets it as the person's own change. `createUndoManager().checkpoint()` records at once (no-op while paused, applying or delegated).
- Grammar panel: a match with exactly one replacement shows "Suggestion: …" and a `TextButton` "Fix" (`aria-label` "Replace …"); several replacements keep one button each. `replaceInSegment` serialises in storage form (no render-only colour classes).
- Tests: `tests/content-insights.test.mjs` (rules with en/de fixtures, fixes, settings service, publish guard opt-in, 2,000-block runner with every slice under 50 ms), `tests/admin/quality-insights.test.jsx`, `tests/admin/undo-checkpoint.test.jsx`.

## Configuration

Defaults and validation in `server/src/config/index.js` (the README has the table): `debug`, `rawHtml`, `sanitizeOnSave`, `encryptionKey`, `uploads.maxImageBytes`, `uploads.maxFileBytes`, `uploads.maxMediaBytes`, `uploads.allowPrivateOrigins`, `linkPreview.enabled`, `linkPreview.timeoutMs`, `api.autoParseJSON`, `ai.allowPrivateBaseUrl`, `ai.apiKey`, `ai.apiKeyBaseUrl`, `ai.requestsPerMinute`, `ai.timeoutMs`, `ai.altText.allowPrivateOrigins`, `languageTool.allowPrivateBaseUrl`, `languageTool.requestsPerMinute`, `languageTool.timeoutMs`, `collaboration.enabled`, `collaboration.path`, `collaboration.allowedOrigins`, `collaboration.pollIntervalMs`, `collaboration.roomTtlMinutes`, `collaboration.maxMessageBytes`, `collaboration.snapshotIntervalMinutes`, `collaboration.tokenTtlSeconds`, `collaboration.maxConnectionsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.maxRoomsPerAdmin`, `collaboration.revalidateSeconds`, `collaboration.rateLimit.sessionsPerMinute`, `collaboration.rateLimit.updatesPer10s`, `collaboration.rateLimit.bytesPer10s`, `collaboration.compaction` (`enabled`, `idleSeconds`, `minBytes`, `ratio`, `checkIntervalSeconds`), `history.maxSnapshotsPerField`, `comments.enabled`, `comments.perMinute`, `comments.mentionsPerMinute`, `comments.notifications` (`email`, `emailPerHour`), `suggestions.enabled`, `suggestions.perMinute`, `links.urlPattern` (validated by `isValidLinkPattern`), `qualityChecks.externalLinks` (`enabled`, `timeoutMs`, `perMinute`, `allowPrivateOrigins`, `schedule`: `enabled`, `rule`, `tz`, `maxUrlsPerRun`, `perMinute`, `perHostConcurrency`), `audit.enabled`, `audit.retentionDays`, `drafts.enabled`, `drafts.ttlHours`, `lazyInit.enabled`, `lazyInit.marginPx`, `mcp.enabled` (2.5), `coreBlocks.enabled` (2.7, default `false`; the Settings switch stored under `settings.coreBlocks.enabled` wins once saved). Environment: `MAGIC_EDITOR_X_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. Read config inside functions, never at module load. Arrays have empty defaults because Strapi merges config arrays by index.

## Editor toolbar and field tools (2.4)

The field toolbar stays short. Visible in the bar: Undo and Redo (not on read-only fields), the **More tools** menu (DS `Menu`, a text button), Full screen, a visible way back while a view-changing tool is on ("Back to editing", "Leave focus mode"), the save hint of a positional field without a saved key, then live collaboration presence/status and the counts. Every other tool of the field is one entry of the field tool registry and appears only in More tools, grouped **Review** (comments, version history, suggestions, quality checks), **Write** (suggest changes, AI for the whole field, grammar check, find and replace, insert template) and **View** (preview, focus mode, keyboard shortcuts). Block-level tools stay where the block is: Editor.js block tunes (incl. the AI tune), the selection bar for selected blocks, comment markers in the gutter.

Registry (`admin/src/editor/field-tools.mjs`, pure; rendered by `components/EditorField/FieldToolsMenu.jsx`; built in `EditorField` as `fieldTools`):

| Key          | Type                                                     | Meaning                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`         | string, unique                                           | Stable name; item `data-testid="mex-tool-<id>"`, exit button `mex-tool-exit-<id>`                                                                      |
| `group`      | `'review' \| 'write' \| 'view'`                          | Menu section (order `TOOL_GROUPS`)                                                                                                                     |
| `label`      | string                                                   | Translated, plain language                                                                                                                             |
| `icon`       | node                                                     | Decorative start icon (`@strapi/icons`)                                                                                                                |
| `shortcut`   | string                                                   | `CMD+SHIFT+F` form (as in `ShortcutsDialog`); shown as `Ctrl+Shift+F`/`Cmd+Shift+F` and set as `aria-keyshortcuts`. The tool keeps its own key handler |
| `badge`      | `{ count, tone: 'primary'\|'warning'\|'danger', label }` | Count in the item (hidden at 0); `label` is the full accessible name with the count                                                                    |
| `pressed`    | boolean                                                  | The tool is a toggle (panel, preview, focus mode): `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked` and a check mark                                             |
| `exitLabel`  | string                                                   | With `pressed`: label of the visible way-back button in the bar while the tool is on                                                                   |
| `visible`    | boolean (default true)                                   | False removes the entry (permission, config, field option, read-only). Hidden entries are still validated                                              |
| `disabled`   | boolean                                                  | Shown but not selectable                                                                                                                               |
| `order`      | number                                                   | Position inside the group; otherwise the given order                                                                                                   |
| `movesFocus` | boolean                                                  | The tool focuses its panel or dialog itself; the menu then does not return focus to its trigger                                                        |
| `onSelect`   | function                                                 | Runs the tool. It runs after the menu has closed and released focus (Radix traps focus in an open menu)                                                |

`groupFieldTools` throws on a missing or duplicate id, an unknown group or a missing `onSelect` (`tests/field-tools.test.mjs`).

How to add a field tool:

1. Build the panel or dialog as a self-contained component with one primary action, a close control and a helpful empty state. Panels render in a `PanelSlot` under the toolbar; dialogs use DS `Modal`.
2. Add one entry to `fieldTools` in `EditorField/index.jsx` (pick the group by what the editor wants to do: review, write or view). Set `visible` from config, RBAC and field options so the item only appears where it can work; new features are off by default.
3. On close, return focus with `focusToolsMenu()` (the More tools trigger), never to `<body>`.
4. A keyboard shortcut goes in the existing key handler of the field plus `shortcut` in the entry and a row in `ShortcutsDialog`.
5. Do not add icon buttons to `EditorToolbar.jsx`; the source test allows exactly undo, redo and full screen.

## Admin and i18n

- Build every screen with `@strapi/design-system` and the admin `Page`/`Layouts`; colours and spacing from theme tokens only (no hex, no `var(--colors-*)`; 1rem = 10px). Destructive actions use `ConfirmDialog`. No `window.confirm`, no `console.log`, no emoji.
- Translation keys live in four areas, `admin/src/translations/{common,editor,tools,settings}/{en,de,fr,es,pt}.json`, prefixed with the area (`editor.history.title`). Every key exists in all five locales; German uses formal "Sie". The `defaultMessage` in code equals the English text. `tests/admin-i18n.test.mjs` enforces parity, ICU validity and no orphans.
- Editor tools in `admin/src/editor/tools` keep the 1.x block names and data. Untrusted strings reach `innerHTML` only through `sanitizeInline`, `sanitizeTemplate` or `sanitizeSvg` from `admin/src/editor/sanitize.js`.
- Every effect survives React StrictMode (mount, cleanup, mount; React 18 and 19), checked by `npm run test:admin`: it cleans up what it starts (timers, listeners, observers, sockets, Editor.js through `isReady.then(destroy)` plus `disposeTools(tools)`, Y.Docs), sends no mutation twice, and a request that StrictMode's cleanup should cancel gets its own `AbortController` signal. A module-level cache or shared in-flight request (editor config, custom blocks, synced sources) uses `getFetchClient` from `admin/src/utils/fetch-client.js`, never the component's `useFetchClient`, which aborts its requests on unmount. Presence heartbeats start on the next task, so an undone mount sends neither a heartbeat nor a leave.

## Releases

Conventional commits (angular preset). A breaking change needs a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer; `!` alone is not counted by the commit analyzer. semantic-release publishes from `main`; the hand-written `## [Unreleased]` section of CHANGELOG.md is folded into the release notes by `scripts/release-unreleased.mjs`.
